We are partners in time and accelerate answers to critical questions through the power of automation. We develop innovations for scientists by scientists, with many of our 3,300+ global colleagues coming from the laboratory.

It’s all part of our time-tested approach to bringing meaningful innovations at the speed of life since 1935. And we’re just beginning. Working together, let’s put our time and talents together to advance human health for tomorrow.

The West&North Field Applications Manager is responsible for the managing Flow application teams in France, UK, Nedherlands and Sweden.

In the role the West&NorthFlow Applications Manager will oversee the implementation of impactful KPIs, leveraging key relationships with internal and external Senior leaders.

This position reports to the EMEA Flow Cytometry Application managr and is part of the Commercial Organization located in EMEA and will be fully remote in France.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

1. Lead a high-impact regional team dedicated to provide Flow application support to West and North Markets, driving strategic initiatives and measurable performance improvements.

2. Collaborate with senior internal and external stakeholders, influencing decision-making and aligning application strategies with broader business goals.

3. Leading support in key markets to build strong relationships and deliver tailored solutions to partners and customers.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor’s degree in science or equivalent and 3+ years’ experience in Science/Medical/Clinical field.

  • High level knowledge in Flow Cytometry with a strong background in Immunology and hematology supported by previous roles in the industry.

  • Leadership and Team Management

  • Experience in managing a regional or cross-functional applications teams

  • Ability to implement and track impactful KPIs to drive performance and alignment.

  • Stakeholder Engagement and Strategic Influence

  • Fluency in English is a must, French language as additional language would be preferred to facilitate the cmmunication with French clinical customers.

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • Ability to travel up to 50% within the region and beyond for essential trainings and meetings.

  • Must have a valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Master’s or PhD degree in a science field.

  • Strong oral and written communications skills.

  • Problem solving and project management skills.

jobs.title: Data Migration Specialist (Syniti) - Remote (Richmond, IN, US, 47374)
jobs.excerpt: Innovation Starts With YouPropel your career at Belden, where innovation creates possibilities—for our people, our customers, and the communities we serve.
jobs.description:
Innovation Starts With You

Propel your career at Belden, where innovation creates possibilities—for our people, our customers, and the communities we serve. We connect people, information, and ideas to solve the world’s most complex connectivity challenges, turning curiosity into meaningful impact. Here, you’ll take on work that challenges you, supports your growth, and empowers you to shape what’s next. You’ll collaborate with global teams, gain diverse perspectives, and contribute to solutions that extend beyond our business—creating value in the world around us.

Together, we are shaping the future of digitization and paving the way for the next generation of innovation.

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled SAP Data Migration expert with extensive experience in SAP data migration projects with previous experience on Syniti tools (ADM or ADMM). The ideal candidate will have a strong background in SAP data models and migration processes, coupled with the ability to interact with cross-functional teams, ensure data quality, and deliver on project timelines.

Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in end-to-end data migration projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives and SAP implementation strategies.
  • Configure data migration tools including Syniti ADMM and BODS for data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes, ensuring accurate and efficient data migration.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define data mapping and migration requirements, scope, and timelines.
  • Develop and implement data migration plans, including data cleansing, validation, and reconciliation processes.
  • Conduct data profiling and analysis to assess data quality and identify issues prior to migration.
  • Coordinate with technical teams to design and optimize data migration processes and workflows.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance and security standards throughout the migration process.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 8+ years of experience in SAP data migration roles for greenfield or brownfield projects. Expertise on data migration methodology (mock cycles, validation approach, etc.) is a must.
  • Proven experience with data migration tools including LTMC, DMC, BODS, Syniti tools (e.g., Syniti ADMM/SKP, Syniti Knowledge Platform) and its various modules including Reporting hub, Migrate & Construct.
  • Experience with legacy SAP data tools like LSMW, MASS, etc.
  • Strong understanding of SAP modules and data structures (e.g., S/4HANA, ECC).
  • Extensive knowledge on SAP Data model (Materials, Business Partners, BOMs, Routings, etc.)
  • Knowledge on configurable materials and associated data objects including material classes and characteristics.
  • Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail, with a focus on data quality and integrity.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • SAP certification in one or more technical areas is a plus.
  • Certification on Syniti ADMM would be preferred.
  • Exposure to Variant Configuration (VC or AVC) would be a plus

Applicants can expect a base compensation range of $101,400 - $152,100 plus benefits and additional incentives based on the level of the role. This is the reasonable estimate that Belden believes it might pay for this job based on applicable circumstances at the time of posting. Belden may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range as permitted by law, and commensurate with the applicant’s experience, qualifications, and geographical location.

Belden also offers hybrid and remote work practices where feasible and provides employees with benefits that could include health/dental/vision, long term/short term disability, life insurance, HSA/FSA, matching retirement plans, paid vacation, parental leave, employee stock purchase plan, paid leave for volunteer work in your community, training opportunities, professional talent management and succession planning, corporate health well-being initiatives and a work culture which includes commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion and sustainability!

Let’s Create Possibilities Together.

Join a global community shaping the future of intelligent connectivity. At Belden, you’ll help push the boundaries of technology and write the next chapter of innovation, creating possibilities for your career, your future, and the world around you.

These statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work involved for this job. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of this job.

jobs.excerpt: Care Navigation and Benefits Specialist - RemoteIf you know the VA system well enough that colleagues have turned to you when a Veteran's situation became complicated, this opportunity may be worth a conversation.
jobs.description:
Care Navigation and Benefits Specialist - Remote

If you know the VA system well enough that colleagues have turned to you when a Veteran's situation became complicated, this opportunity may be worth a conversation.

We're looking for an experienced care navigation professional who can bring that knowledge to a growing Veteran-focused care coordination program. You'll help Veterans navigate healthcare, benefits, behavioral health services, community resources, and other support while also helping the broader care team handle complex cases more effectively.

What makes this position particularly interesting is the opportunity to do more than manage individual cases. You'll serve as a resource to other care coordinators, help improve Veteran-specific workflows, identify gaps in the program, contribute to training, and help shape how care coordination is delivered as the program develops.

The Experience That Matters Most

We're particularly interested in someone whose background brings together Veteran or VA experience, care coordination, and increasing program responsibility.

You'll need:

  • 5+ years of experience as a clinical social worker, care coordinator, care navigator, or in a similar field, with demonstrated progressive program management experience
  • Direct experience working with Veterans and/or within the VA system
  • 1+ years of experience working successfully in a remote environment
  • Knowledge of VA healthcare, Veteran benefits and resources, behavioral health, and social determinants of health
  • Experience supporting medically and/or behaviorally complex populations
  • Experience documenting cases within a care management or electronic health record system
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills

Experience with motivational interviewing is also important.

A social work license is not required, although candidates with credentials such as an LMSW or similar professional background are encouraged to apply. Fluent Spanish is helpful but is not required.

How You'll Make an Impact

You'll help Veterans understand and navigate available resources, including VA healthcare, benefits, community care, and other services that address healthcare and social needs.

You'll also guide complex Veteran cases, help determine appropriate referrals and escalations, and step in with direct Veteran support when specialized assistance is needed.

Beyond individual cases, you'll help develop Veteran-specific care coordination workflows, identify opportunities to improve the program, and work with care coordination and training leadership to strengthen the team's understanding of VA healthcare, benefits navigation, Veteran resources, and common barriers to care.

In short, your experience will help both the Veteran in front of you and the team supporting the Veterans who come next.

Location, Schedule and Compensation

This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week remote position working Monday through Friday during normal Central Time business hours.

Candidates must reside in the Central Time Zone in Texas, Alabama, Mississippi, Louisiana, or Tennessee and have a dedicated home-office environment.

The anticipated salary range is $80,000 to $100,000, with potential flexibility based on the selected candidate's experience and background.

Travel is not required.

If you've spent several years helping Veterans navigate complex healthcare or benefit systems and you're ready for a position where that experience can influence a broader program, we'd like to talk with you.

Seeking an OMS Support Architect with deep expertise in IBM Sterling Order Management System (OMS) to support and evolve a highly integrated enterprise order management ecosystem.

This individual will serve as the technical leader for OMS architecture, implementation support, transaction analysis, system integrations, and platform optimization. The ideal candidate possesses strong functional knowledge of order management processes while also understanding the technical architecture required to support sourcing, inventory visibility, fulfillment, and order orchestration within a complex enterprise environment.

The Architect will work closely with business stakeholders, development teams, and enterprise architects to drive scalable OMS solutions, troubleshoot production issues, and support ongoing platform enhancements.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide architectural leadership and implementation support for IBM Sterling OMS.
  • Support and optimize OMS capabilities including:
    • Sourcing
    • Inventory Visibility
    • Order Hub
    • Order Orchestration
  • Analyze and troubleshoot end-to-end order lifecycle transactions across OMS and connected applications.
  • Lead solution design efforts and evaluate configuration versus customization approaches.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable OMS solutions.
  • Support development and QA teams by providing technical guidance and acceptance criteria.
  • Analyze integration failures, data flows, payloads, and transaction exceptions to determine root causes.
  • Design and support integrations between OMS, ERP, WMS, eCommerce, EDI, and supply chain platforms.
  • Document architecture, business processes, system interfaces, and technical dependencies.
  • Drive continuous platform improvement, scalability, performance optimization, and operational efficiency.
  • Lead coordination between onshore and offshore teams to ensure successful delivery of OMS initiatives.

Qualifications:

  • 5–9+ years of IBM Sterling OMS experience, specifically with Sourcing, Inventory Visibility, Order Hub, and Order Orchestration.
  • 2+ years leading onshore/offshore teams in a Technical Lead or Architect capacity, driving requirements, acceptance criteria, and solution delivery.
  • Experience designing OMS solutions, evaluating customization vs. configuration, and optimizing platform performance.
  • Experience deploying or supporting OMS solutions in cloud environments (IBM Cloud preferred).
  • Strong understanding of enterprise integrations, APIs, and end-to-end order management processes.
  • Excellent stakeholder communication skills with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • OMS integrations with SAP, Oracle, Dynamics 365, Blue Yonder, Manhattan, or Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
  • Experience with omni-channel fulfillment (BOPIS, Ship-from-Store, Dropship, Returns).
  • Kafka, MuleSoft, Azure Integration Services, or other middleware/integration platforms.
  • Experience supporting large-scale retail, distribution, or supply chain environments.
  • Automation, testing, and OMS modernization experience.

jobs.companyName: Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey
jobs.description:
Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey empowers our members to achieve their best health. For over 90 years, we have been New Jersey’s health solutions leader driving innovations that improve health care quality, affordability, and member experience. Our members are our neighbors, our friends, and our families. It is this understanding that drives us to better serve and care for the 3.5 million people who place their trust in us. We pride ourselves on our best-in-class employees and strive to maintain an innovative and inclusive environment that allows them to thrive. When our employees bring their best and succeed, the Company succeeds.

About the Role

This position supports the Clinical Operations functions and acts as a liaison between members, physicians, delegates, operational business members and member service coordinators. Responsible for providing leadership and guidance to non-clinical team and handle escalated issues/problems.

What You'll Do

  • Performs review of service requests for completeness of information, collection and transfer of non-clinical data, and acquisition of structured clinical data from physicians/patients.

  • Prepare, document and route cases in appropriate system for clinical review.

  • Initiates call backs and correspondence to members and providers to coordinate and verify benefits and courses of treatment.

  • Collect and collate information required to handle escalated phone/correspondence inquiries.

  • Upon completion of inquiry investigation/resolution, initiate call back or correspondence to physicians/members to coordinate/verify case completion.

  • Assist with on-boarding and training of newly hired Managed Care Coordinators I.

  • Acts as liaison with providers, members and Care Managers.

  • Perform other relevant tasks as assigned by management.

Utilization Management:

  • Non Clinical staff is not responsible for conducting any UM review activities that require interpretation of clinical information.

  • Performs initial screening of precertification requests from physicians/members received via incoming calls or correspondence using established scripts and workflows under the oversight of clinical /supervisory staff.

Case Management:

  • Makes outbound calls to in order to engage members in Case Management and to complete the necessary health assessment(s) (IHS/HRA, CNA/CMNA, MLTSS Elig Survey*).

  • Distributes new case assignments to the Case Management Clinical Staff.

  • Reviews medical, dental and vision claims and address gaps in member's preventative care.

  • Educates members regarding preventive health activities and services.

  • Assists members making appointments with their PCP, specialists, and/or transportation, etc. Process PCP, demographic changes and new ID cards as requested by members.

  • Review medical and administrative documentation for accuracy, grammar, and compliance with regulatory standards.

  • Make sound, timely decisions under the direction and supervision of a designated Supervisor.

  • Review medical and administrative documentation for accuracy, grammar, and compliance with regulatory standards in both English and Spanish.

  • Translate clinical and non-clinical documents between English and Spanish, ensuring precise medical terminology and context.

  • Assist in the onboarding and training of new Managed Care Coordinators, providing guidance on language protocols and workflow processes.

What You Bring

Education/Experience:

  • High School Diploma/GED required.

  • 3-5 years customer service experience.

Additional licensing, certifications, registrations:

Knowledge:

  • Requires knowledge of medical terminology

  • Requires Good Oral and Written Communication skills

  • Requires ability to make sound decisions under the direction of Supervisor

  • Prefer knowledge of contracts, enrollment, billing & claims coding/processing

  • Prefer knowledge Managed Care principles

  • Requires knowledge of clinical standards of care, and Star measures.

  • Requires operational knowledge of health care delivery systems and health insurance industry.

  • Requires appreciation for strategic planning.

  • Requires knowledge of NCQA accreditation standards as well as state and federal laws applicable to health plan appeals and grievances. (Letters Team, Medically Certified Spanish Translator)

  • Requires knowledge of CMS and state regulatory requirements. (Letters Team, Medically Certified Spanish Translator only)

Skills and Abilities:

  • Prefer the ability to analyze and resolve problems with minimal supervision

  • Prefer the ability to use a personal computer and applicable software and systems

  • Team Player, Strong Analytical, Interpersonal Skills

Travel:

  • May require some travel.

The Solutions Marketing Associate helps Sales create more quality client conversations while delivering fast, polished support for everyday opportunities. This role sits closest to the front end of the sales funnel: helping sellers identify the right accounts, do their homework, personalize outreach, and turn established marketing materials into relevant client-facing presentations.

For standard and smaller opportunities, typically $100K or less, the Associate uses existing positioning, narratives, templates, research, case studies, and proof points to efficiently build tailored sales materials without recreating strategy from scratch. At the prospecting stage, the Associate gives sellers the account intelligence and lead development support they need to earn more meetings.

This role builds the intelligence and inputs behind outreach but does not conduct cold calling, prospecting outreach, or appointment setting.

The north star is twofold: help Sales get into more of the right conversations, and help them show up to those conversations prepared.

What You’ll Do

Prospecting & Meeting Generation Support

  • Identify and research target accounts that fit priority audiences, verticals, solutions, or seller territories.

  • Build and maintain actionable lead and account lists with the context sellers need to prioritize outreach.

  • Research target companies, key contacts, recent business developments, marketing activity, competitive context, and relevant signals that can create a reason to engage.

  • Prepare concise account briefs and outreach inputs that help sellers personalize emails, calls, and meeting requests.

  • Connect prospect needs and business signals to relevant Digital Remedy capabilities, proof points, content, and conversation starters.

  • Partner with Sales on focused prospecting initiatives and campaigns designed to generate qualified meetings.

  • Track which research, prospecting themes, and materials are helping sellers open doors and use those learnings to improve future support.

Sales Presentations & Everyday Opportunity Support

  • Support standard and smaller opportunities, typically $100K or less, by tailoring existing presentations and materials to the customer and opportunity.

  • Build polished client-facing decks using established templates, positioning, solution narratives, case studies, research, and proof points.

  • Quickly identify the most relevant existing materials instead of rebuilding presentations from scratch.

  • Perform light account, category, audience, or competitive research when needed to make an established story more relevant.

  • Ensure materials are accurate, on-brand, easy for sellers to present, and aligned with established messaging.

  • Escalate opportunities that require original research, custom strategy, or a new problem-led narrative to the Solutions Marketing Analyst or Manager.

Sales Alignment & Enablement

  • Serve as a highly responsive day-to-day partner to Sales, understanding seller priorities, pipeline needs, and recurring friction points.

  • Help sellers navigate available materials, case studies, research, and solution stories so they can self-serve effectively when appropriate.

  • Capture recurring requests and content gaps and share them with the Solutions Marketing Manager and Product & Enablement team.

  • Support broader sales and marketing initiatives that create demand, improve seller preparedness, or accelerate opportunities.

What Success Looks Like

  • Sellers have a consistent pipeline of well-researched accounts and stronger reasons to reach out.

  • Prospecting support contributes to more qualified meetings and new sales conversations.

  • Smaller and standard opportunities receive fast, polished, relevant presentation support without unnecessary custom development.

  • Sales spends less time searching for materials and researching accounts and more time engaging customers.

  • The Associate knows when to activate existing materials and when an opportunity should be escalated for deeper strategic support.

What You Bring

  • 1-3 years of experience in sales development, sales support, marketing, research, enablement, account planning, or a coordinator/associate role.

  • Strong research instincts and genuine curiosity about companies, industries, buyers, and business challenges.

  • Strong PowerPoint or Google Slides skills and good visual judgment.

  • Ability to turn research into concise, usable seller talking points and outreach inputs.

  • Excellent organization and ability to manage multiple fast-turn requests.

  • A proactive, service-oriented mindset paired with the confidence to ask questions and recommend a better path when needed.

  • Familiarity with CRM, prospecting, sales intelligence, and research tools is a plus.

  • Interest in developing toward solutions marketing, insights, strategy, or sales enablement.

Position Summary

EverCommerce is seeking a Vice President, FP&A to lead the financial planning and analysis function for the EverHealth vertical business unit. Reporting to the EverCommerce CFO, this leader will serve as the primary finance partner to the EverHealth executive leadership team and will be responsible for translating operational performance, revenue trends, investment decisions, and strategic priorities into clear financial plans, forecasts, recommendations, and executive narratives.

The Vice President, FP&A will lead the EverHealth FP&A team, including two direct reports and one offshore resource, own the development of EverHealth’s annual operating plan, rolling forecast, performance reporting, and business operating reviews, and partner closely with Revenue Operations, Product, Engineering, Accounting, Legal, and HR. The right candidate will combine strong financial judgment, analytical rigor, executive presence, and a practical operating mindset in a multi-business software environment.

Key Responsibilities

EverHealth Financial Leadership

  • Serve as the senior finance leader for EverHealth, advising the leadership team and corporate finance leadership on financial performance, risks, opportunities, and strategic tradeoffs.
  • Lead annual operating planning, budget development, rolling forecasts, long-range planning inputs, and monthly reforecast processes across revenue, gross margin, Operating Expense, EBITDA, cash-impacting items, and headcount.
  • Build and maintain a clear financial narrative for EverHealth performance, including drivers of actuals, forecast variances, bookings risk, revenue conversion, expense pacing, and investment capacity. Primary finance support for quarterly board materials and ad hoc support in earnings process.
  • Translate financial and operating data into actionable recommendations for executive decisions, resource allocation, prioritization, and performance improvement.

Business Partnership

  • Lead monthly and quarterly financial review processes, including forecast-to-actuals reviews, variance analysis, dashboard interpretation, and follow-up actions with operating leaders.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations and commercial leaders on bookings, pipeline, pricing, retention, implementation capacity, bad debt, credits, and revenue forecast accuracy.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering on capitalization, product investment, operating metrics, roadmap affordability, headcount planning, and ROI of strategic initiatives.
  • Partner with Accounting, Legal, and Corporate Finance on accounting close alignment, EBITDA adjustments, accruals, indemnity/litigation matters, and finance governance.
  • Oversee financial review and approval workflows for headcount, job requisitions, operating expenses, vendor spend, travel, and other budget-impacting decisions.

Executive Reporting and Strategic Decision Support

  • Prepare and refine executive-level materials for EverHealth SLT sessions, CFO/Finance ELT meetings, board-facing materials, Annual Operating Plan (AOP) presentations, QBR/MBR content, and strategic planning discussions.
  • Develop and maintain financial models that support revenue planning, expense management, business cases, commercial strategy, operating metrics, and acquisition/integration or portfolio decisions where applicable.
  • Ensure dashboards, reporting packages, and recurring analytics provide a reliable view of EverHealth performance and prompt the right operating conversations.

Team Leadership and FP&A Operating Model

  • Lead, coach, and develop the EverHealth FP&A team, setting a high bar for analytical quality, business partnership, responsiveness, and ownership.
  • Establish clear planning calendars, review cadences, task ownership, and quality standards for forecast files, revenue actuals, OpEx files, budget timelines, and executive deliverables.
  • Improve FP&A processes, systems usage, data quality, and automation so the team spends more time on insight and decision support and less time reconciling versions.
  • Build strong relationships across the vertical and corporate functions, operating as a trusted partner who can challenge assumptions constructively and move work across functions.

EverCommerce is committed to equal pay and transparency. The annual base salary range for this position is $240,000-275,000 USD Per Year plus bonus. The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada – if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. jobs.description:
About the Role:

We’re building AI into STARLIMS, a platform used across quality manufacturing, life sciences, public health, forensics, and environmental sciences.

This role is focused on agentic systems: software that reasons over a task, calls tools, works through multiple steps, and hands the result to a person to review and approve.

Our users work under strict accuracy, traceability, and validation requirements. The engineering challenge is making non-deterministic systems reliable, observable, and controllable enough to be trusted, tested, and shipped.

You’ll work on both the platform and runtime our agents execute on and the production agents built on top of it.

What You’ll Work On:

Agent Platform & Runtime (Core Focus)

  • Design and build the runtime our agents execute on: planning and execution loops, tool calling, state management, durable execution, and failure recovery
  • Build the layer through which agents reach platform data and external systems safely
  • Design coordination, delegation, and handoff across agents and workflows where needed
  • Make agent behavior versionable, testable, measurable, and regression-safe across releases
  • Build reusable primitives so new agents are configured rather than rebuilt from scratch

Building Agents (Core Focus)

  • Take a domain workflow from expert conversation to a working agent: goals, actions, execution flow, failure handling, and success criteria
  • Ground agent decisions and outputs in authoritative enterprise data rather than relying on model knowledge alone
  • Implement human-in-the-loop by design, including approval gates, override capture, uncertainty handling, and clear evidence for agent decisions. Agents recommend and draft; people decide
  • Close the loop: turn user corrections and overrides into signals that measurably improve the agent

Evaluation & Reliability

  • Build evaluation harnesses for multi-step behavior, not single-response accuracy: task completion, tool-call correctness, groundedness, trajectory quality, and regression across model, prompt, and tool changes
  • Define production metrics for agent quality, reliability, latency, cost, and human intervention rates
  • Implement guardrails, fallbacks, timeouts, cost ceilings, and end-to-end observability and tracing across agent runs
  • Design safeguards against prompt injection, unsafe tool use, excessive permissions, data leakage, and other agent-specific security risks
  • Manage prompt evolution, model drift, and non-determinism while maintaining consistent, measurable system behavior across releases

Integration & Data

  • Integrate agents with platform APIs and third-party enterprise systems already running in our customers’ environments
  • Build retrieval and context pipelines that turn fragmented enterprise data into reliable, permission-aware agent context
  • Design controlled execution paths for automated actions, with a complete, traceable audit trail

Platform & Infrastructure

  • Build and operate backend services on AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Step Functions, etc.)
  • Own significant parts of the system architecture and contribute to key technical decisions
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code and deployment pipelines

Tech Stack

  • Languages: TypeScript, Python
  • Backend: Node.js, Python, AWS Lambda, Step Functions
  • AI: OpenAI, Anthropic, MCP and related agent/tool protocols, embeddings and vector search
  • Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS
  • Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform
  • Testing: Jest, Playwright, pytest

What We’re Looking For

Must Have

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience, including production systems
  • Experience building production LLM systems, including tool-using or multi-step agentic workflows beyond simple prompting and chat interfaces
  • Strong understanding of LLM behavior, limitations, and failure modes, especially how errors compound across a multi-step run
  • Experience with LLM APIs, tool and function calling, and designing planning and execution loops
  • Experience evaluating and debugging non-deterministic systems
  • Solid backend and cloud experience (AWS or equivalent)
  • Proficiency in TypeScript and/or Python

You Should Be Comfortable With

  • Debugging across distributed and non-deterministic systems
  • Making explicit tradeoffs between accuracy, latency, reliability, and cost
  • Working in ambiguous problem spaces where the right architecture isn't obvious yet
  • Owning production systems end-to-end
  • Choosing conventional software over AI when AI isn't the right solution

Nice to Have

  • C#, Microsoft .NET Framework
  • Tool and interop protocols such as MCP
  • Evaluation pipelines and metrics built specifically for agentic systems
  • Experience in regulated or domain-heavy systems (validation, audit trails, controlled change)
  • Retrieval and grounding techniques for supplying agent context
  • Workflow and durable-execution platforms (Temporal, Step Functions, n8n, etc.)
  • Containerization and orchestration (ECS, EKS, Kubernetes)
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar)

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Exacom, a Motorola Solutions company, provides mission-critical recording solutions for public safety, government, military, and critical infrastructure agencies. Our team supports customers with reliable technology, direct support, and a customer-focused approach to complex recording and data capture environments.


Job Description

Motorola Solutions is looking for a Product Manager to own Product Management across the Hindsight recording platform. You'll be responsible for licensing and subscription management, system integrations, product roadmap, and delivering a unified emergency communications recording experience across the Hindsight suite of products. You'll be part of an empowered product team operating with a startup mindset inside a large enterprise. Reporting to the Director of Product Management for Hindsight, you'll own the billing foundation that powers monetization across our unified platform, working directly with engineering, finance, and operations to build systems that scale. This role is hands-on: you'll run discovery, define outcomes, ship products, and measure results.

Responsibilities:

Run Continuous Discovery: Talk to customers, finance teams, and operations stakeholders regularly. Conduct interviews, observe billing workflows, analyze usage and payment data, and synthesize what you learn into clear problem statements and opportunity assessments.
Ship Product That Matters: Work with engineering and design to move from problem to solution to delivery. Write clear product specs, make scope trade-offs, and ensure what ships actually solves the problem you set out to solve.
Measure Impact: Define success metrics for your area and instrument your product to track them. Use data to inform decisions, validate hypotheses, and demonstrate business impact.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work with Finance, Sales Operations, ERP teams, and other product teams within Motorola Solutions to ensure feature changes are coordinated, launches are clean, and feedback from the field shapes the roadmap.
Understand the Landscape: Stay sharp on emergency communication trends. Use that knowledge to inform how Hindsight structures features, pricing, packaging, and subscription management.
Competitive Product: Build competitive analysis and review where our product stands in the overall market.
Sales/Marketing Enablement: Work with the sales and marketing teams to to align product catalogs and sales materials to achieve smooth go to market processes.

Qualifications:

Bachelors Degree with at least 5+ years of professional experience in a high tech environment with 3+ years of product management experience in SaaS, cloud platforms, or enterprise software.

Experience with emergency communications systems, radio systems, call handling systems or cloud hosted platforms.

Demonstrated ability to run customer discovery and translate findings into product decisions.

Comfortable working directly with engineering teams, including the ability to engage in technical discussions about architecture and trade-offs.

Experience defining and tracking product metrics, and using data to drive prioritization.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate product strategy and rationale to both technical and non-technical audiences.

A bias toward action and learning over perfection, with experience shipping product iteratively.

What Sets You Apart:

AI Fascination and Vibe Coding Experience: Gone are the days when only the engineers could code. We expect you to be able to stand up AI generated prototypes rapidly and iterate on them.

Multi-Sided Ecosystem Thinking: You've worked with products that serve multiple stakeholder types (partners, installers, integrators, end-users) and understand the trade-offs involved.

Job Description Summary

On our team, we look for that rare professional who is both analytical and a relationship-builder. Those who can combine those talents with their entrepreneurial drive and own and manage their territory can thrive and grow with us. If this sounds like the opportunity you've been looking for, we want to hear from you!

As a Senior Territory Manager, you'll work primarily middle market accounts, with an emphasis in commercial lines construction services, representing some of our most complex and sophisticated distribution partners. You'll market, manage and underwrite business through direct contact with select agencies or brokers. We'll count on you to drive profit and premium to meet top financial goals and objectives. To succeed, it will be important to collaborate with internal business partners to support and increase the overall Nationwide presence.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitors market conditions, competitive landscape and confirms information gathered within market space. Researches risk, environment and factors necessary to win the account.

  • Analyzes quality and quantity of risks underwritten and prepares reports accordingly. May review agency books of business as well as profit/growth results and trends to recommend and implement action plans. Analyzes regional underwriting performance experience, identifies problems on a territory level and proposes action plan to resolve those situations. Performs analysis of the most complex accounts that require combining experience, intuition and business savvy to make strategic territory and account decisions.

  • Achieves production, profitability and service objectives. Quotes, prices and underwrites new and renewal policies and endorsements, primarily for complex or service sensitive accounts. Monitors risk selection and pricing decisions for entire agency plant. Decisions require review of multiple variables, using agency relationships, inspection reports and evaluation of exceptions. Navigates complex interactions necessary to influence sophisticated producers and customers. Independently reviews for acceptability and handles those within level of authority using company underwriting guidelines and standards.

  • Manages workflow and intricacies of underwriting a significant volume of assigned work using company tools and systems. Ensures file handling quality and workflow efficiency. Manages large, complex work and coordinates work with and through others to meet service level agreements. Facilitates the successful delivery and execution of select agency business plans.

  • Drives robust agency business planning to deliver detailed performance plans with actions, accountabilities and scheduled performance checkpoints. Ensures strong territorial objectives to maximize profit and pipeline management. Proactively finds opportunities for all lines of business and refers to appropriate business leaders. Considers sophistication of partners, navigates organizational complexities and mines for ancillary opportunities through promotion and negotiation techniques. Plans and coordinates the efforts of the team on new business, renewals, service plans, etc. Identifies prospects and recommends new agency appointments.

  • Markets Nationwide products and services to help drive agency and company results, including all products that may improve offerings. Assists agency with strategies for pipeline management, producer development and developing new business in targeted industries and preferred markets. Assesses accounts and develops business propositions to win business.

  • Consults with agents and internal partners to develop business solutions. Shares understanding of organizational capabilities and opportunities to drive maximum value of relationships. Consults regarding the appetite, acceptability, terms, conditions, pricing and sales techniques of large or unique businesses. Provides industry trend observations to leaders. Consults with agencies regarding risk management and coverage options and to improve retention and profitability. Proactively identifies and consults on new business and growth strategies.

  • Communicates with agencies to establish the company as the provider of choice for the territory for all enterprise products with an emphasis on commercial lines. Communicates product, technology changes and company objectives. Communicates market intelligence to agencies and leaders. Communicates and collaborates actively with team and leaders to share industry trends, and field underwriting experience.

  • Completes agency visits as appropriate to develop new accounts, service existing accounts, review agency performance and enhance agency relationship. Builds and maintains strong business relationships with agency leaders, producers and key groups.

  • Leads delivery of appropriate customer service levels. Follows up and ensures proper handling of customer service requests.

  • Ensures that tools, training and support are in place to positively impact success for the agencies and territory. Identifies and communicates training needs and opportunities. May assist in the development or training delivery as a subject matter authority.

  • Participates in program and product orientation meetings in conjunction with Sales/Marketing partners as the underwriting subject matter authority. Provides professional development knowledge and insight to team. May help mentor and coach new Territory Managers.

  • Manages a significant workload effectively and backs up others as needed. Monitors business plan results to measure performance and develops action plans to ensure alignment with underwriting philosophies, standards and performance expectations. Reviews business in process, lost business and drives implementation of business plan. Leads discussion for assigned agents in agency reviews. Ensures that unique agency business capabilities are assessed and emphasized as a competitive advantage.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred.

License/Certification/Designation: Relevant professional designation such as CPCU or CIC is preferred.

Experience: Seven years of progressively more responsible underwriting and sales experience in commercial business preferred. Expertise in markets consistent with our underwriting appetite and product portfolio preferred.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Extensive working knowledge of commercial underwriting, pricing and coverage for middle market business. Knowledge of company sales and underwriting standards and philosophies, company products and programs and state statutes. Strong knowledge of effective sales, marketing and agency relationship management techniques. Excellent interpersonal and sales skills. Ability to build and maintain cooperative and mutually rewarding internal and external partnerships. Must have the ability to perform duties with independent judgment within underwriting authority and company underwriting standards. Demonstrated decision-making ability required in day-to-day operations where there may be unclear or competing priorities, including evaluating and recommending solutions to customer service, work processing, underwriting selection and rating and compliance. Job Title: Director - LIMS Strategy - CPG & F&B

Job Location: Barcelona, Spain

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Systems has built the first modern cloud LIMS system, and we are hiring a Director of LIMS Strategy, QualityOne, to accelerate our growth across global accounts in the Food & Beverage, Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), and Chemical Ingredients industries.
In this high-impact role, you will architect and execute the commercial strategy for our LIMS product line within these target sectors. You will act as the ultimate bridge between sales, marketing, product, and services, unifying them into a cohesive market vision while developing and personally delivering key messaging, training sales teams, and establishing industry thought leadership.
We are seeking a visionary leader with deep expertise in laboratory informatics, strong market intuition, and relevant experience in the Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) supply chain who can seamlessly pivot from high-level strategy to hands-on, day-to-day execution.

What You'll Do

Market Expansion & Growth

    • Drive Market Entry: Own the growth and market penetration of Veeva LIMS for QualityOne across target FMCG and their supply chain sectors
    • Act as a Commercial Leader: Operate in a high-visibility, customer-facing commercial capacity to drive positive outcomes for both customers and Veeva

Job title: Deal Origination Analyst — Broker & Owner Sourcing

Location: 100% remote; candidates must be based in the United States or Canada and available during North American business hours

Everis is hiring an early-career analyst to build the pipeline of businesses we may acquire. You will research markets and companies, build relationships with brokers, contact owners, qualify opportunities, do initial analysis, and hand the strongest deals to our acquisition team with clear notes.

This is a sourcing and relationship role, not a traditional investment-banking role. Your main responsibility is high-quality deal flow. You will see evaluation, diligence, and transactions, but the deal team owns complex modelling, diligence, negotiation, and execution.

Why join Everis

  • Work directly on acquisition strategy and see how a lead becomes a serious opportunity.

  • Speak with brokers, advisers, founders, and owners while learning what makes a business attractive and why owners sell.

  • Research varied industries, use modern AI and sourcing tools, take ownership quickly, and grow into broader acquisition responsibilities.

About Everis

Everis is a software holding company with $27 million in annual recurring revenue. We buy B2B SaaS companies from the founders who built them and keep them permanently. We invest our own capital and operate without the pressure of a fund exit timeline. Our remote team strengthens engineering and product, pricing, go-to-market, retention, revenue operations, and back-office systems across the portfolio.

What you’ll work on

Broker and intermediary relationships

  • Find and build relationships with relevant brokers, advisers, marketplaces, and other deal sources.

  • Stay in regular contact, understand what they have coming to market, and follow up consistently.

  • Screen brokered and marketplace opportunities against Everis’s criteria and surface the strongest ones quickly.

Owner sourcing and outreach

  • Build targeted lists of businesses and owners that may fit our criteria.

  • Find and verify decision-maker contacts, then run thoughtful outreach by phone, email, LinkedIn, referrals, and other relevant channels.

  • Hold initial conversations, understand each owner’s goals, and follow up professionally over what may be a long cycle.

Research and qualification

  • Understand what each business does, how it makes money, who its customers are, and what makes it defensible.

  • Gather high-level information on revenue, profit, growth, recurring revenue, customer concentration, owner involvement, asking price, sale motivation, and timing.

  • Assess fit, prepare short opportunity briefs and notes, and coordinate a clean handoff to the deal team.

Pipeline ownership and improvement

  • Keep the acquisition CRM accurate, including contacts, source, stage, notes, next action, financial snippets, risks, and follow-up dates.

  • Track outreach, responses, meetings, qualified opportunities, handoffs, and funnel progression. Provide concise weekly reporting.

  • Use evidence and AI tools to improve research, outreach, recordkeeping, and the sourcing methods that produce the best opportunities.

What we’re looking for

  • Evidence of exceptional ability through one specific, verifiable accomplishment with unusual difficulty, selectivity, or impact—and a clear explanation of what you personally contributed.

  • Alternatively, direct acquisition experience that includes all three: analysing small or mid-sized SaaS or mobile-app businesses, judging their attractiveness as acquisition targets, and engaging owners or founders about acquisition fit or motivations.

  • Strong research and commercial judgment, with the ability to understand unfamiliar businesses and communicate credibly with brokers, advisers, owners, and founders. You are smart, curious, and able to learn quickly.

  • Excellent spoken and written communication. You are comfortable making cold calls, sending outbound messages, hearing no, and following up consistently without relying on finance jargon.

  • Highly organized, reliable, proactive, and resilient. You maintain accurate notes, follow through on commitments, handle confidential information with integrity, and work effectively without constant supervision.

  • Comfortable using spreadsheets, CRM systems, research databases, and AI tools, with basic financial and commercial literacy or the ability to learn quickly.

This role is designed for candidates with zero to three years of professional experience. Prior acquisition or sales experience is not required when a candidate demonstrates exceptional ability. Generic sales results, outreach volume, list building, financial modelling, credentials, or employer prestige do not establish a strong match on their own.

What we offer

  • US$70,000–$85,000 base salary plus an annual performance bonus of up to US$15,000.

  • 100% remote work from the United States or Canada.

  • Direct exposure to founders, brokers, owners, and real acquisition opportunities.

  • Meaningful responsibility early, with a path into senior deal origination, acquisitions, or broader operating work.

If you want to learn how great businesses are found and directly help build Everis’s acquisition pipeline, we’d like to hear from you.

Compensation Range: $70K - $85K

jobs.description:
The Clinical Research Associate is responsible for the site management, site monitoring and close-out of assigned clinical trials investigator sites to ensure patient safety and quality study execution in accordance with applicable prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices, and Pfizer standards.

The Clinical Research Associate role is accountable for site management and monitoring, managing investigator site relationships to ensure effective delivery of clinical trials (e.g. enrollment, database release), to safeguard the quality of investigator sites (e.g. patient safety, site quality and compliance with GCP), to maintain investigator and site staff engagement and satisfaction, and to enhance the company’s image with its external stakeholders.

The Clinical Research Associate is responsible for the resolution of all protocol-related issues for assigned investigator sites and will work closely with the Site Care Partner, and other members of the study team, as required, in activities associated with the set-up, running and close out of sites in a clinical trial.

Clinical Trial Monitoring

  • Ensure proper conduct of clinical trials in accordance with the Study Monitoring Plan and applicable prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices, and Pfizer standards to achieve project goals, timelines and quality;

  • Manage assigned operational aspects for implementation of clinical trial activities at assigned investigator sites from site initiation through to database lock, ensuring relevant timelines and quality deliverables are met;

  • During study conduct, serve as the primary point of contact for assigned investigator sites. Work in partnership with and/or escalate to the SCP to ensure quality of site delivery;

  • Interface with the study team as needed, facilitate information flow between members of the study team, vendors and assigned investigator sites;

  • Partner with SCP to perform investigator site development, coaching and training of site personnel to ensure ongoing compliance with protocol and the safeguarding of patients; provide protocol training to, and address protocol related questions from the investigator site staff when required, including discussions on known/anticipated operational and clinical trial risks;

  • Attend investigator meetings when required (virtual or F2F);

  • Provide enrollment support and ensure progress by responding to site activation and recruitment issues from investigators. Partner with SCP and the study team to define and support recruitment initiatives at site level;

  • Conduct remote assessment of e diary data;

  • Conduct onsite, remote/electronic monitoring as needed for study site initiation, routine monitoring and study site closure activities and ensure these are conducted accordance to the Study Monitoring Plan, SOPs and commensurate with emerging issues and technologies;

  • Monitor site level AEs and SAEs and collaborate with the Drug Safety Unit and follow-up with investigators sites, as needed, to bring SAE reports required information to resolution;

  • Submit all required reports, documentation, updates and tracking within required timeframes, including but not limited to Trial Master File documentation, site reports, site follow up letters, protocol deviations, patient recruitment, clinical supply management, study progress and metrics;

  • Identify and resolve investigator site issues within required timeframes; agree and develop corrective and preventative actions with investigator and site personnel to close open issues and to prevent recurrence/persistence of issues;

  • Resolve data queries within required timelines, prepare investigator site close-out plan and conduct close-out activities within required timelines;

  • Ensures adequate oversight of the investigational product at the investigator site, including receipt, handling, accounting, storage conditions, and destruction activities;

  • Support database release as needed;

  • May undertake the responsibilities of an unblinded monitor where appropriate. Clinical/Scientific and Site Monitoring Risk:

  • Annotate structure: identify and bound every meaningful region of the page - document title, section heading, paragraph, list, table, figure, diagram, caption, formula, question, answer field - and assign each a component type and a reading-order index.
  • Record relationships: link each region to the figure or table it belongs to through a parent component identifier.
  • Transcribe faithfully: reproduce all text exactly as it appears in Bengali script, including handwritten content, flagging any region where the source is not legible.
  • Capture page metadata: language, document type, source, page dimensions, and flags for tables, formulas, and handwriting.
  • Review a colleague's work: every task is reviewed end to end by a second Bengali expert, and experienced annotators take on that review.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • Native Bengali speaker with full command of the script, its diacritics, and its conjunct forms.
  • Experience with documents: annotation, transcription, translation, localization, subtitling, proofreading, journalism, or regional-language data review.
  • Exact character-level accuracy; a single wrong diacritic is a defect.
  • Systematic application of a taxonomy across hundreds of pages.
  • Comfort with unfamiliar layouts: multi-column newspapers, exam papers, handwritten forms.

Preferred

  • Regional-language AI data: annotation, labeling, grading, or bilingual evaluation for training datasets.
  • Transcription and localization: MTPE, subtitling, bilingual QA, OCR correction or post-editing.
  • Document production: typesetting, copy-editing, proofreading, or digitization of Bengali-language material.
  • Script and encoding: Unicode normalization, Bengali input methods, numeral-form and character-form accuracy.

jobs.description:
At LegitScript, we are passionate about making the internet and payment ecosystems safer and more transparent. We help companies of all sizes keep their services legal and safe for consumers. To do this, LegitScript combines big data with the world’s leading team of experts skilled in highly regulated and complex sectors, including transaction laundering detection, pharmaceuticals, online gambling, and more.

The result? Unmatched accuracy and deep risk analysis that identifies which commercial entities play by the rules, and which do not. Our diverse industry partnerships provide unique insights that keep businesses and governments at the forefront of emerging trends. That’s why LegitScript is trusted by the world's largest search engines, internet platforms, payment companies, and regulatory agencies.

Overview:

Strategy is worth what gets delivered. At LegitScript, the Director of Product Execution owns that delivery. You will own the portfolio view, run the prioritization process, and build the operating discipline that turns product direction into shipped, measured outcomes. You are not the author of the strategy or the products — your product managers own that work — but this role exists to make it count for more.

You will run prioritization on consistent criteria in a forum where the reasoning is visible, so the ranking is trusted by the teams whose work is deferred, not only the teams whose work is chosen. You will protect focus as roadmaps grow, hold every bet to a shared readiness standard, and close the loop by measuring what actually happened after launch. This is a leadership role with hands in the work: you lead through your product managers while staying close enough to the details to catch a vague requirement, an unowned dependency, or a metric that will not tell us anything.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the portfolio view: what is committed, what is in flight, what is at risk, and what has been deliberately deferred.
  • Own the prioritization process end to end, including the cadence, the criteria, and the forum where bets are ranked and the outcome is published.
  • Set and hold the readiness bar for work entering the plan: a defined problem, an intended outcome, a measure, an owner, and both signatures.
  • Drive scope discipline, breaking large bets into increments that deliver value on their own and retiring work that no longer earns its place.
  • Identify and resolve cross-squad dependencies, sequencing conflicts, and capacity contention before they become delivery risk.
  • Own the operating cadence for product, including planning, prioritization, roadmap review, launch readiness, and retrospectives.
  • Run launches end to end from the product side, including readiness, enablement, communication, and post-launch measurement.
  • Lead, coach, and grow the product management team, owning hiring, performance, and career development.
  • Set the standard for product craft, including problem definition, discovery, requirements, and success metrics.
  • Review product managers' work and give feedback that raises the standard, from sharper problem statements to clearer requirements.
  • Define and track execution metrics, including delivery predictability, cycle time, scope change, and effort spent on abandoned work.
  • Report progress to engineering leadership, the strategy organization, and the executive team with clarity and a clear point of view.

What You'll Bring:

jobs.description:
Marketing Manager

Remote, South Africa. Full-time, permanent, UK hours. R30,000 per month.

Read this before you apply

This is a senior seat at a company of four people. Nobody will train you and nobody has time to check your work. If you need a manager to break tasks down for you, this is not the job. If you have run the whole marketing channel for a small business and you are good at it, keep reading.

The company

Our client is a London-based AI training and transformation consultancy, a year and a half old, founder-led, growing. They teach leadership teams what AI can actually do for their business, then build it with them: data readiness, workflow analysis, AI literacy training, custom AI agents. Two founders, a small payroll, and a fractional CMO who sets direction.

The job

You run marketing end to end for a small, fast-growing business. The fractional CMO owns the strategy, the calendar and the priorities. Everything downstream of that is yours: you take the brief and you deliver it, properly, without being chased and without being taught.

You will be across all of it, social, content, email, events, analytics, paid. But we are not looking for someone who is average at everything. We want you to be genuinely strong in one or two areas and competent across the rest.

What you will actually do

  • Take a brief from the fractional CMO and execute it end to end, first time, to a standard nobody has to correct
  • Build and ship email campaigns and automated sequences in ActiveCampaign, including event follow-up flows segmented by who attended and who did not
  • Own the content and publishing calendar across LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram
  • Write. Short-form copy, campaign emails, social, show notes. You will not have a copywriter sitting next to you
  • Run the SEO programme: what topics the business should own, and the content that wins them
  • Run and optimise paid campaigns where they earn their place, and report honestly on what they cost and what they returned
  • Own comms for live events and online workshops, announcement through to post-event follow-up
  • Keep the tracking honest and produce a monthly report that tells the founders what moved and why
  • Use AI properly in daily production, not as a novelty

What you need

  • You have owned marketing end to end at a small business, a startup, or directly for founders. Not a slice of a large corporate marketing department. If your best work was one channel inside a big company, this will not suit you and we would rather say so now
  • Real depth in one or two areas. SEO and content, or Meta and paid social, or email and lifecycle, or analytics and attribution. Be excellent at something
  • Numbers you can defend. Not "improved engagement". What was it before, what was it after, what did the business get, and how do you know. You will be asked to walk through a campaign in detail, including what it cost per lead and why that figure is credible
  • Technical by instinct. You pick up new tools quickly, you have built things yourself, and you use AI because you understand what it can do, not because it is fashionable
  • You deliver alone. Remote, lightly managed, off a written brief, on time
  • Experienced enough to have been there and done it. This is not a first or second marketing job

Nice to have

  • ActiveCampaign specifically, though any serious automation platform transfers
  • Event marketing
  • Podcast or video production
  • Experience marketing a B2B service to business leaders

Two things we will ask you directly

What else are you contracted to do? This is a full-time role and it has to be your only one. We ask everybody, and we ask it first.

Walk me through a campaign you ran, with the numbers. Three of them, with the starting point as well as the finish. If you cannot do that from memory, do not apply yet.

What you get

Full ownership of marketing delivery at a company selling the thing every business is currently trying to work out, with a fractional CMO who knows what he wants and tells you clearly. Full-time, permanent, UK hours, paid in rands into a South African account. Employed through Remote Recruitment, working as part of the client's team.

Equipment

Reliable laptop, stable fibre, quiet professional home working setup.

Process

A recorded screening interview with us, then a task and a final conversation with the founder and the fractional CMO. You will hear back within 24 hours of every stage.

We build AI-first. We expect you to work fluently with AI coding agents as a daily multiplier - scoping work for them, reviewing what they produce with a critical eye, and building the internal tooling, context, and evaluation habits that make the whole team faster.
If you’re passionate about building high-quality Android experiences that scale, and love shipping apps that power gaming, virtual currency, and digital commerce experiences, we would love to hear from you!

ABOUT US

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain our native Android application in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, used by players and developers worldwide.

  • Work with cross-functional teams, including backend developers, QA engineers, and project managers, and communicate effectively across distributed, multi-timezone teams.
  • Participate in technical discussions to align development work with business objectives.

Architecture & Design

  • Design and implement scalable application architecture for Android with a focus on maintainability, performance, and developer experience.
  • Lead architectural decisions around modularization, dependency injection (Hilt/Dagger), navigation, and state management (MVVM, MVI, unidirectional data flow).
  • Configure and optimize the Gradle build, convention plugins, version catalogs, build caching, and configuration cache, for fast, incremental builds.
  • Build and maintain an internal Compose component library and design system implementation.
  • Establish and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and best practices across the mobile development team.
  • Create technical specifications and architecture documentation for complex features and systems.
  • Partner with the iOS and React Native engineers to keep shared API contracts, design tokens, feature flags, and analytics schemas coherent across the app family, without flattening the platform into a lowest common denominator.
  • Drive observability for mobile: structured logging, crash monitoring, performance tracing, and release health dashboards.

AI-First Engineering

  • Use AI coding agents and assistants as a core part of your daily workflow, and raise the bar for how the team prompts, reviews, and verifies AI-generated code.
  • Build and maintain the context that makes agents effective in our codebase: project rules, tool integrations, reproducible dev environments, and automated checks that catch what review misses.
  • Design evaluation and guardrails for AI features, including prompt regression testing, fallback behavior, and handling of model failure modes in production.
  • Share what works: mentor engineers on AI-assisted development and help set practical, quality-preserving standards for the organization.

Qualifications & Skills

  • 5+ years of professional Android development experience, with deep, hands-on expertise in Kotlin.
  • Proven track record of shipping commercial Android applications, with apps you built currently live on Google Play.
  • Strong command of modern Android frameworks and idioms: Jetpack Compose, Coroutines and Flow, Lifecycle, Room, WorkManager, and Navigation.
  • Strong understanding of Android architecture patterns (MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture), dependency injection, and state management.
  • Experience with automated testing on Android: JUnit, Compose UI tests, Espresso, Robolectric, and with CI/CD for Android release pipelines.
  • Solid grasp of performance, memory, and battery profiling using Android Studio Profiler, Macrobenchmark, and Baseline Profiles.
  • Experience building for a fragmented device and OS-version landscape, including large-screen and foldable form factors.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Experience with third-party integrations, REST/GraphQL APIs, and mobile SDK consumption.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and a results-driven approach.
  • Effective communication skills, both written and verbal.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with app widgets, deep linking, push notifications (FCM), or background work at scale.
  • Experience bridging Kotlin modules into React Native, or with Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Familiarity with Google Play Billing and alternative billing / external offer programs.
  • Familiarity with gaming ecosystems, virtual currency platforms, in-app purchases, or alternative payment and digital commerce flows.
  • Experience with mobile security practices: secure storage, certificate pinning, obfuscation, and fraud prevention.
  • Contributions to open source, technical writing, or conference talks in the mobile or AI engineering space.

Our culture

At CloudFactory, we believe in building a workplace where everyone feels empowered, valued, and inspired to bring their authentic selves to work. We are:

  • Mission-driven: we focus on creating economic and social impact.
  • People-centric: we care deeply about our team's growth, well-being, and sense of belonging.
  • Innovative: we embrace change and find better ways to do things, together.
  • Globally connected: we foster collaboration between diverse cultures and perspectives.

Location: Japan
Project type: One-time paid project
Time commitment: Approximately 1–2 hours
Compensation: $75 for completing the project activity

About the opportunity

CloudFactory is looking for participants to support a short-term transaction validation project that we are administering on behalf of a global payments processing company.

The project is designed to help evaluate the accuracy of how payment transactions are matched to individuals.

As a participant, you'll review a set of recent payment transactions and indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself.

How it works

If selected for the project:

  1. You'll provide the email address(es) you use with selected merchants, subscriptions, apps, or online accounts.
  2. Our payments processing client will use those email address(es) to identify payment transactions it believes are associated with you and securely provide a list of those transactions for the project.
  3. You'll be presented with approximately 50 recent transactions from the last 3 months through the designated project platform. The information shown may include details such as the merchant name, date, amount, payment method, card identifier, and card issuer to help you recognize each transaction.
  4. You'll indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself and, where helpful, add a short note.

The activity is expected to take approximately 1–2 hours.

You will not be asked to provide or upload your own transaction history, bank statements, full card number, online banking login credentials, banking password, PIN, or CVV.

Please note that this is a data validation activity only.

Requirements

To participate, you must:

  • Be 18 years of age or older.
  • Currently reside in Japan.
  • Be an active debit and/or credit card user.
  • Have made purchases or payments within the last three months across a variety of merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be able to recognize your own recent purchases and transactions.
  • Have access to the email address(es) you use with the merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be comfortable providing those email address(es) if selected for the project.
  • Be willing to review approximately 50 transactions and confirm whether or not you recognize them as your own.

Privacy and consent

Because this project involves personal and financial transaction information, privacy and informed consent are essential.

Before participating, you'll receive our Participant Consent & Confidentiality Terms, which explain how your personal information and transaction data will be used and processed as part of the project.

If you qualify and provide your consent, relevant payment transactions will be securely provided to CloudFactory by the end-customer and made available to you through the designated project platform for validation.

You may withdraw your consent and participation in accordance with the terms provided to you before the project begins.

Interested? Complete our short eligibility questionnaire to be considered for this paid project.
