jobs.description:
US LBM is one of the leading and fastest growing distributors of specialty building materials in the United States, with a team of over 13,000 employees located throughout the country. Since our founding in 2009, we have acquired over 100 companies and have expanded to more than 450 locations serving 37 states. US LBM is a progressive organization that promotes a unique culture that focuses on the value of its customers and associates. Developing our people is critical to our strategy and fostering our culture of empowerment.

.

A Brief Overview

The US LBM Lead Software Engineer (Digital Workplace) will provide technical leadership while working hands-on alongside software engineers developing highly available applications, integrations, and automations across US LBM's digital workplace, collaboration, identity, endpoint management, intranet, and workflow automation, built on Microsoft 365, Workday, and a modern identity and endpoint stack.


This role combines hands-on engineering with technical leadership, product partnership, and business engagement. The Engineering Lead will partner with Product Managers, Architects, and business stakeholders to align technology delivery with business objectives and guide teams through design, development, deployment, and support.


Above all, this is a builder's role at the leading edge of US LBM's move to an AI-First software development lifecycle. Partnering closely with the Product Manager, the Lead Engineer will own use-case discovery and rapid prototyping, quickly turning ideas into working proof-of-concepts that demonstrate business value across the organization, and will lead their team in adopting AI across how we discover, design, build, test, and ship software. If you want to help define how a 13,000-person company builds software in the AI era, this is that role.


What you will do

  • Partner with the Product Manager to own use-case discovery and rapid prototyping, identifying, testing, and proving out AI and technology opportunities across the organization, and turning them into working proof-of-concepts
  • Drive your team toward an AI-First software development lifecycle, embedding AI across discovery, design, coding, testing, code review, and delivery

About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture-first organization driven by four core values: Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen (Continuous Improvement), and Collaboration. We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on.

About the Role

The company is seeking an experienced, systems-driven Business Operations / Project Manager with a strong AdTech Background to transform informal workflows into owned, structured, and scalable operational systems. As the primary connective layer across departments, this role focuses on process kaizen, SOP governance, and end-to-end operational enablement—ensuring teams execute efficiently without reinventing processes.

The Business Operations / Project Manager will manage the central project management infrastructure and partner directly with Product and executive leadership. Key responsibilities include preparing cross-functional teams for product launches, streamlining enterprise client workflows, and establishing organization-wide standards for accountability and visibility. As a data- and AI-fluent operator, the candidate will design structured spreadsheet models, integrate AI tools to accelerate documentation, and continuously optimize reporting systems.

Core Responsibilities

1. Process Kaizen & SOP Governance

  • Run a continuous improvement cadence across the process landscape; killing, combining, or improving SOPs weekly. Own the process vault and ensure every process is signed off by its owner and governed for adoption, not just documented.


2. Project Management & Visibility

  • Own and maintain internal Notion project management tracker; ensuring all projects, to-dos, and tickets are tracked, visible, and actioned. Drive adoption beyond the department, building the systems foundation for a company-wide model with long-term integration into business line weekly meetings, as aligned with product operating model.


3. Product Rollout Support

  • Support product release processes, structuring the operational side of launches so teams are enabled ahead of go-live. Work closely with Group Product Manager to formalize this process as a repeatable model.


4. Cross-Departmental & Enterprise Client Enablement

  • Act as an operational connective layer across business lines and enterprise client workflows; surfacing blockers, coordinating data and documentation needs, and keeping cross-functional commitments visible and actioned.


5. Data & Spreadsheet Management

  • Own data pulls and spreadsheet-based reporting for departmental initiatives; Building and maintaining structured, reliable, and scalable systems and models that others can use without re-deriving logic. Comfort with formulas, structured data, and dashboard hygiene is core to the role.

Who You Are

  • The Experienced Operator: You have 4+ years of experience in a process, project management, or business operations role. Ad tech, SaaS, high-data-volume or WordPress ecosystem experience is a plus, as is experience working with Salesforce (SFDC).
  • The Systems Builder: You default to structure, and you know the difference between owning a process and doing the work inside it. Given a messy or untracked workstream, your instinct is to define ownership, standardize steps, and build the scaffolding (trackers, SOPs, cadences) that lets other functions execute reliably.
  • Data- and AI-Fluent: You're comfortable pulling, cleaning, and structuring data in spreadsheets without hand-holding, and you've used AI tools in your actual workflow to speed up documentation and process work.
  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: You can walk into an undefined workstream, ask the right questions, and leave it with clear ownership and a repeatable process.
  • Direct Communicator: You flag problems early and plainly. You don't let a stalled ticket or an unsigned SOP sit quietly.


What We Offer

  • True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with an flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle.
  • Professional Development: Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company.

The ideal candidate has practical experience setting up, maintaining, and troubleshooting advertising pixels, events, conversion tracking, and analytics systems, with a strong understanding of how paid traffic is measured and optimized.

You will work closely with the marketing team to ensure that campaigns are properly tracked, conversions are accurately recorded, and our tracking infrastructure provides reliable data for reporting and optimization. This role is particularly suited to someone who enjoys working directly with ad platforms, analytics tools, event tracking, and campaign data rather than focusing solely on strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set up, manage, and troubleshoot Meta Pixel, Meta Events Manager, and custom events/conversions.

  • Support paid advertising campaigns across platforms such as Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.

  • Define and maintain a clear event tracking structure, including event names, parameters, properties, and conversion definitions.

  • Implement and validate pixels, events, conversion tracking, UTM parameters, and other tracking solutions across websites and campaigns.

  • Work with the tracking stack, including PostHog, GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Meta Events Manager, Brevo, and Microsoft Clarity.

  • Monitor tracking performance and investigate discrepancies between advertising platforms, analytics tools, and website data.

  • Test and validate events across different platforms to ensure that data is being captured accurately and consistently.

  • Ensure that key events and conversions are properly defined, recorded, and attributed across the relevant platforms.

  • Assist with campaign setup, audience tracking, retargeting, and conversion measurement.

  • Analyze campaign and tracking data to identify potential issues and opportunities for improvement.

  • Work with websites, landing pages, and analytics tools to ensure proper data collection and attribution.

  • Help maintain organized tracking documentation and ensure that event naming and tracking structures remain consistent.

  • Stay up to date with changes to advertising platforms, tracking technologies, attribution, and privacy requirements.

  • Support testing and troubleshooting of new tracking setups before campaigns go live.

Preferred Experience

  • Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, Meta Pixel, Meta Events Manager, and custom events/conversions.

  • Experience with TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.

  • Practical experience with PostHog, GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Microsoft Clarity, and Brevo.

  • Strong understanding of event tracking concepts, including event names, parameters, properties, conversion definitions, and attribution.

  • Experience troubleshooting tracking issues and identifying why events or conversions may not be firing, recording, or attributing correctly.

  • Familiarity with server-side tracking / Conversions API is a strong plus.

  • Experience with newer or emerging advertising platforms, including ChatGPT Ads, would be a significant advantage.

  • Comfortable working with data, spreadsheets, dashboards, and campaign performance reports.

  • Strong attention to detail and a hands-on, problem-solving mindset.

What We’re Looking For

The ideal candidate should be able to go beyond simply setting up campaigns or implementing pixels. They should understand how the entire tracking flow works, from defining an event and its parameters to ensuring that it fires correctly, is captured by the relevant analytics tools, and is ultimately reflected as a meaningful conversion.

You do not need to be an advanced developer, but you should be confident working with tracking tools, advertising platforms, basic website elements, and analytics systems. Experience working across multiple paid media channels and the ability to quickly learn and troubleshoot new platforms are highly valued.

Senior Frontend Engineer (Product Engineering)

Remote · Eastern Hemisphere (timezone overlap required)

FINN is a fintech company building simple and transparent products that improve financial well-being for underbanked employees. Our core offering gives people access to wages they have already earned, alongside tools to help them manage money better, build savings, access insurance, earn additional income, and use fairer financial services.

Founded in 2022, FINN is the largest player in the early wage access space in Southeast Asia and is expanding rapidly into new markets globally. We are looking for ambitious builders who take ownership, move fast, and want to shape products that create meaningful impact in people’s lives.

This is a high-ownership IC role. You'll work alongside our Frontend Lead and a small team (currently 3, scaling to 5+), shipping features end-to-end across web and mobile.

What you'll do

  • Build and ship complex, user-facing features across web and mobile (Angular + Ionic)
  • Own features end-to-end: dig into the problem, design the approach, ship fast, and iterate based on real usage
  • Contribute to technical direction — advocate for better patterns, tooling, and developer experience
  • Partner with product and design to define solutions, not just execute specs
  • Write clean, performant code at a high pace — quality and speed, not one or the other
  • Raise the bar for the team through code reviews, technical input, and leading by example

How we work

We're a small team that values clear thinking over heavy process. Engineers get real context on the "why" and autonomy on the "how." We ship frequently, learn from production, and make pragmatic tradeoffs. We plan enough to move confidently — but never so much that we slow down.

AI in our workflow

AI is becoming core to how we build. We use LLMs daily for coding, debugging, automated code reviews, design doc reviews, and we're building internal tooling to push this further in and out of the Engineering team. We expect engineers to use AI as a force multiplier in their daily work — and to contribute ideas on how we can do it better.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years shipping complex user-facing products in production (web + mobile ideal)
  • Strong product instincts, you push back when something doesn't feel right for the user
  • Deep TypeScript fundamentals (component architecture, state management, performance)
  • Ability to operate independently: you take ownership of a problem and drive it forward
  • Pragmatic judgment on architecture vs. shipping and learning
  • Clear communicator who can articulate tradeoffs and advocate for their approach

Our stack is Angular + Ionic. Strong engineers from React, Vue, or other modern frameworks ramp quickly — we care more about fundamentals than specific framework experience.

This role probably isn't for you if

  • You aren't comfortable with some level of ambiguity
  • You default to large rewrites when the problem needs solving in days
  • You optimize for architectural purity over learning from real users
  • You need a lot of structure or guidance to do your best work

Why join

  • Your work directly shapes the product experience for hundreds of thousands of users
  • Small, high-caliber team — minimal bureaucracy, fast feedback loops, clear business impact
  • High autonomy and real ownership from day one
  • A seat at the table in defining how frontend engineering evolves here

jobs.description:
Are you looking for a Challenge? Looking for an innovative organization and the opportunity to learn and grow professionally? We can help! We are seeking a Learning Management Systems Administrator to support the Federal Trade Commission.

I’ve never heard of Terrestris. What do you do?

At Terrestris, we leverage technology to create better mission outcomes through better human performance. We form strong client and team relationships through transparency and strive to create an environment where our team can let their excellence shine through. By finding, developing, and incorporating new ideas, we provide memorable services. Rooted in the USMC values of honor, courage, and commitment, Terrestris seeks to deliver extraordinary value to the American people by helping the Government become more efficient and effective.

So, what will the Learning Management Systems Administrator at Terrestris do?

As the Learning Management Systems Administrator, you will have primary responsibility for the functional and technical operation and enhancement and maintenance of FTC’s Learning Management Systems (LMS) eTrain2 operating on the Cornerstone platform, and the processes and standards governing its use. The LMS supports training across all mission critical areas, and you will be responsible for designing and applying appropriate workflows and business processes to ensure that required training data is captured and maintained in accordance with applicable standards and FTC business requirements. You will coordinate LMS development and operations adhering to FTC’s technology standards and processes and serve as the designated security officer (DSO) for the application.

What does a typical day look like for the Learning Management Systems Administrator?

You will be responsible for:

  • LMS Operations and Maintenance:
    • Manage day-to-day operations of the LMS, ensuring functionality, reliability, and accessibility for users.
    • Configure system settings, permissions, roles, and hierarchies to meet organizational needs.
    • Perform regular updates, patches, and upgrades to the LMS platform.
    • Primary point of contact for LMS daily operations and end-user support.
    • Maintains and monitors system performance.
    • Partner with the team, instructors, and vendors to ensure optimal use of the LMS.
    • Identify process and quality improvements, providing feedback on usage, defects, and enhancements.
    • Monitor monthly releases for upcoming system changes and deployments.
  • User Management:
    • Create, update, and deactivate user accounts as necessary.
    • Monitor and troubleshoot user access issues, ensuring timely resolution.
    • Provide guidance and technical support to end-users, instructors, and course designers.
    • Generate and analyze user activity reports to identify engagement trends or system issues.
    • Create and manage user structures including the creation of user groups and learning cohorts.
    • Manages course enrollment including progress tracking.
  • Course Management:
    • Publish and archive online or blended learning solutions, assign training curricula, and add and delete resources.
    • Manage the course asset library.
    • Populate course information and assign learners.
    • Develop and update standardized tools and reporting for ongoing access to learning information; generate standard and custom reports.
    • Analyze reporting data and recommend strategic direction to Chief Learning Officer, technical managers, or others, as appropriate.
    • Create and manage the overall course structure and set up course programs based on specifications from the instructional designer.
    • Manage tracking of course revisions and history.
    • Build online assessments and evaluations in LMS for courses.
    • Manage relationship with third party vendors and facilitate the successful linkage of courses to FTC’s LMS.
    • Assign and manage learning paths, certifications, and compliance training.
  • Troubleshooting:
    • Provide troubleshooting assistance for users regarding logging in to the LMS and accessing courses.
    • Troubleshoot and resolve issues relating to system functionality and software systems.
    • Serve as point of escalation for support issues, which may include interaction with LMS vendor and other vendor support services.
    • Work with the instructional technologist and instructional designers to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to accessing the LMS and course content.
  • Reporting and Analytics:
    • Develop and generate custom reports on user progress, course completion, and compliance.
    • Provide data insights to support organizational learning strategies.
  • Documentation and Training:
    • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) and user guides for the LMS.
    • Conduct training sessions for users, administrators, and course creators on LMS functionality.
    • Document system changes, configurations, and integrations for reference.

What qualifications do you look for?

You might be the systems administrator we’re looking for if you have:

  • Certification as a Cornerstone Administrator.
  • A minimum of 3 years’ experience as a Cornerstone LMS administrator working within the government sector.
  • Technical skills including troubleshooting, and understanding of directory, file structures, and systems.
  • The ability with course design and development.
  • The ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.
  • The ability to collaborate with others at all levels of the organization as well as vendors.
  • Customer service skills and a responsive attitude.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills; ability to communicate complex technical concepts in layman’s terms.

What kind of benefits does Terrestris Offer?

We offer outstanding benefits including health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, and work-life programs. Our award programs acknowledge employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our service standards. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in our benefit programs. Other offerings may be provided for employees not within this category.

Terrestris is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.

About The Job
Title: Vice President of Paid Search
Department: Paid Search
Location: Remote
Employment Type: Full Time

Who We Are
Clever Digital Marketing (CDM) is a performance marketing agency trusted by the largest home improvement companies across North America. We specialize in scaling client growth through full-funnel paid media strategies and deep business consulting. CDM’s success is powered by its industry-leading reputation for exceptional service delivery and performance, with growth driven almost entirely by client referrals and expansion.
Our Paid Search division is a major engine of that growth. We manage seven-figure monthly SEM investments, build high-performance systems, and deliver predictable, scalable lead generation and profitability — not vanity metrics.
Our agency thrives on accountability, transparency, proactive leadership, and results, with a culture built on extreme ownership, high standards, and a relentless pursuit of performance. We expect leaders to operate with authority, clarity, and calm pressure, and to bring decisive energy to high-stakes environments.
As we continue to scale rapidly, we are hiring a Vice President of Paid Search to architect the future of our SEM organization and lead one of the most high-impact departments at CDM.
The Opportunity
CDM is seeking a Vice President of Paid Search to lead the overall operations, strategy, and future direction of one of the most strategically important divisions in the company. This role is built for a leader with a never-ending passion for Paid Search; someone who lives and breathes SEM, understands the complexity of performance ecosystems, and excels at navigating the constantly evolving landscape of search marketing.
You’ll be the architect of a best-in-class department— shaping the systems, people, processes, and strategic direction that define how CDM delivers performance at scale. Your leadership will set the pace and standards for our A-player environment, championing a culture of performance excellence, clarity, accountability, and high output, while striking a balance with the empathy and support needed to build healthy, motivated, and high-performing teams.
This is a role for a true builder — a strategic operator who has scaled teams, led seven-figure spend lead-generation programs, and built systems that create predictable performance in high-stakes environments. You will transform ambiguity into structure, guide with presence and authority, and partner closely with executive leadership to shape the future of CDM’s Paid Search offering.
Strong experience leading seven-figure monthly spend, especially in lead generation, is essential for success in this role.

Key Responsibilities

Department Leadership & Vision
  • Own the full vision, roadmap, and operational direction of the Paid Search division.
  • Build, scale, and evolve the organizational structure, roles, processes, and standards.
  • Architect a high-performance, high-output culture rooted in clarity, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Provide leadership presence that inspires confidence across clients, internal teams, and the executive suite.
Performance Strategy & SEM Excellence
  • Oversee the strategy, execution, and optimization of high-volume, seven-figure paid search programs across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and emerging platforms.
  • Set the strategic direction for PPC tactics, testing frameworks, funnel structure, and cross-channel alignment.
  • Define the department’s measurement philosophy and ensure consistent adoption of performance frameworks, KPIs, and reporting standards.
  • Lead department-wide adoption of new technologies, tactical innovations, and platform opportunities.
  • Oversee complex performance landscapes including CRO, landing pages, creative, automation, analytics, and dev-supported initiatives.
Client Impact & Revenue Growth
  • Oversee the SEM strategy that drives client retention, scale, and profitability across large high-stakes accounts.
  • Partner with Client Services on audit development, pipeline support, and onboarding enhancements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve client performance, enhance efficiency, and build competitive advantages in the home improvement vertical.
Operational Excellence & Systems Building
  • Design and optimize departmental workflows, SOPs, reporting frameworks, QA processes, and operational systems.
  • Develop training programs, internal certification pathways, and centralized knowledge assets for all SEM functions.
  • Build scalable systems that allow the department to 4–10x output without sacrificing quality.
  • Improve forecasting, spend allocation models, profit optimization, and budgeting processes.
Team Development & Leadership Pipeline Building
  • Lead, develop, and mentor senior managers (minimum of 5+ direct reports).
  • Recruit, hire, and onboard top-tier SEM talent, building new roles and specialty divisions as needed.
  • Create personalized growth plans, performance improvement pathways, and coaching rhythms.
  • Ensure performance management rhythms (quarterly evals, coaching cycles, compensation alignment) are upheld with consistency and clarity.
  • Uphold and model CDM’s culture and core values of extreme ownership, integrity, collaborative success, continuous improvement, and results with speed.
Cross-Functional Leadership & Executive Partnership
  • Work closely with Client Services, Paid Social, Creative, CRO, Data/Analytics, and other department heads to unify CDM’s strategy.
  • Collaborate with the executive team on annual planning, department forecasting, P&L oversight, and long-term strategic investments.
  • Support new product development, market expansion initiatives, and enterprise-level growth decisions along with ongoing agency and department innovations to continuously evolve and improve agency deliverables and client results.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Who You Are
You are a high-performance executive who blends deep SEM expertise with strategic clarity, operational discipline, and exceptional leadership presence. You think like an owner, operate like a builder, and lead with the confidence and composure of someone who has repeatedly delivered results in high-stakes environments.
You bring a rare combination of rigor, curiosity, empathy, and decisiveness — the traits that inspire teams, elevate standards, and create scalable excellence. You don’t wait for direction. You create it. You don’t react to problems. You anticipate and prevent them. At the core, you are:
  • Relentless About Performance: You thrive in environments where excellence is expected and accountability is non-negotiable. You instinctively tie strategy to performance, performance to profitability, and profitability to long-term scale. For you, results aren’t an outcome — they’re a responsibility.
  • A Proactive, Forward-Thinking Operator: You don’t just manage. You anticipate, plan, pressure-test, and act. You stay several steps ahead — of the market, the platforms, the team, and the competition.
  • Analytical, Commercial, and Systems-Minded: You see SEM through the lens of business impact and operational scale. You think in frameworks, processes, and levers. Data isn’t noise — it’s direction.
  • Assertive With Empathy & Confident Humility: You push when it’s right and listen when it matters. You hold high standards without losing the trust, respect, and loyalty of your team.
  • Calm, Clear, and Commanding Under Pressure: When stakes are high, you bring clarity. When challenges arise, you bring direction. When ambiguity appears, you bring structure.
  • A Builder at Heart: You thrive in environments where something needs to be created, improved, or scaled. You bring order to complexity, develop people, and build systems that outlast you.
  • Curious, Coachable, and Growth-Minded: You seek mastery in your craft and depth in your understanding. You ask sharp questions, pursue continuous learning, and welcome feedback as fuel.
Qualifications
Requirements:
  • 12+ years of comprehensive Paid Search / SEM experience.
  • 5+ years in a senior leadership role overseeing paid search teams.
  • 5+ years directly managing $1M+ in monthly performance advertising spend within lead generation environments.
  • Proven experience scaling a department (ideally 4×+ growth) through systems, people, and strategy.
  • Direct experience hiring, training, and managing senior SEM leaders and multi-layered teams.
  • Demonstrated success in building departmental processes, onboarding systems, and operational frameworks.
  • Strong track record leading cross-functional strategic initiatives (e.g., CRO, dev, analytics).
  • Experience partnering with executive leadership on forecasting, revenue planning, and P&L impact.
Preferred:
  • 6+ years Director-level leadership in agency environments.
  • Experience with CRO, landing page development oversight, or multidisciplinary performance functions.
  • Experience overseeing 6+ direct reports and departments of 15+.
  • Exposure to home improvement, home services, or lead generation industries.

Benefits

Benefits of Working at CDM
  • Competitive base salary + performance-based bonuses
  • Flexible remote work environment with option for in-person collaboration (Vaughan, ON)

Job Title: Clinical Trials Associate (US)

Job Location: Virtual United States North Carolina

Who we are

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

What the Clinical Trial Associate does at Worldwide

As a Clinical Trials Associate, you are responsible for providing administrative and project tracking support to the clinical project team, ensuring tasks for all assigned projects with Project Delivery services are performed timely and accurately.

What you will do

  • Arrange and track system access for project team (Project Managers, Lead CRAs, CRAs, etc.)

  • Maintain and quality audit to assure the most recent revisions of documents are on project portals

  • Assist project team with preparation and shipment of clinical trial documentation, including Investigator Site File

  • Maintain version and quality control of project documentation and submit to trial master file

  • Assist with the tracking and maintenance of project related information, including site medical question and answer log

What you will bring to the role

  • Excellent written and verbal English as well as fluency of the language of the country of location

  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and exercise independent judgment

  • Strong attention to detail and focus on quality of work

  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills

  • Excellent skills in MS Office applications including Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint

Your experience

  • Degree level qualification or equivalent experience plus a minimum of one years’ experience in a related role

  • Skill sets and proven performance equivalent to the above

At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable workplace by providing transparent compensation.

The salary range for this position is annually (For hourly paid positions, the stated salary range reflects hourly rates):


United States of America - $16.83 - $33.65

The salary range provided is intended to give candidates an understanding of potential earnings. Compensation will fall within the provided range, and it not a guarantee of exact salary. The final salary will be determined based on relevant experience, performance, education, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive benefits package depending on location. We ensure pay equity and transparency and comply with all applicable labor laws. Salary information will be discussed during the interview process, and we encourage candidates to inquire about compensation at any stage.

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.

jobs.description:
Location: Europe. Being in the UK, Germany or Sweden is a small plus for market proximity and occasional travel, but it is not a requirement.

About Pet Media Group

Pet Media Group (PMG) is a scale-up that acquires, launches and develops market-leading pet and equestrian marketplaces globally. We operate eight brands across seven markets in the UK, US, Germany, Sweden, the Netherlands, Italy and Spain. Every year, 1.7 million pets and horses find a new home through our platforms, and some of our flagship platforms include Pets4Homes.co.uk, Deine-Tierwelt.de and Lancasterpuppies.com.

The pet rehoming experience has remained largely unchanged for decades. At PMG, we are on a mission to transform this process by making it more trusted, safe and convenient through innovative technology. We are a driven and ambitious team with a track record of building unicorns, backed by top-tier investors such as Verdane. As a company, we have been profitable since our first year, meaning we do not rely on investor capital for our growth.

The opportunity

This is our first dedicated PR hire and it covers the whole group. Over the years, PMG has managed to reduce animal welfare issues on our platforms far below any peer, through ID verification of breeders, AI-assisted moderation of adverts, a zero-tolerance approach to illegal puppy imports and unlicensed high-volume breeding, and by going far beyond what the law requires. Your job is to tell the world about it.

We know the playbook works because we have already done it once. In the UK, we have changed the public conversation about Pets4Homes from risky classifieds to the most trusted and responsible way to find a pet. Our annual Pet Industry Report is now a fixture in the national press and TV. The challenge is doing that in more than one market at a time.

That is the job: take a proven single-market playbook and make it run in seven, as one person backed by AI tools and outside help where needed, rather than a department.

Your edge is finding the story inside the data and knowing exactly which angle will make a journalist stop scrolling. You bring an AI-forward mindset, the instinct to ask how can I leverage myself through AI, and you use it daily for data analysis, drafting, localising, and getting a story out across markets, so covering seven markets does not mean seven times the work.

What you will do

  • Turn our marketplace data into publishable stories: pricing and demand trends, breed rankings, most popular puppy names, buyer surveys on preferences and the like. One shared instrument based on real-time data and identical core survey questions across markets.

  • Build and run the group editorial calendar, planned per market around seasonal hooks such as heatwaves, fireworks, International Puppy Day and so on, so we are ready before the news cycle asks.

  • Own our trust and safety transparency reporting: listings blocked, scams intercepted, buyer money protected, illegal import patterns by origin, for distribution to journalists and animal welfare stakeholders alike.

  • Mine breeder reviews, Trustpilot and support conversations for the human stories regional press actually run.

  • Become PMG's press desk, so the journalist relationship belongs to PMG rather than to an agency.

  • Brief and equip country leads and founders as spokespeople: talking points, Q&A, data appendices, prep before interviews.

Requirements

Must-have experience

  • 5+ years in PR, communications or journalism, preferably in-house, with coverage in national or major regional media that you personally landed. Data journalism experience is a strong plus.

  • A track record of building stories out of data rather than distributing press releases. You can spot the angle a journalist will want before they ask, and you are comfortable enough with spreadsheets and dashboards to find it yourself and sanity check a number before a reporter does.

  • Daily, active use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT for research, drafting, localisation and workflow automation. You think in terms of how to leverage yourself through AI, not around it, with a clear view of what to automate and what stays human.

  • Native-level English, written to a standard that needs no editing before it reaches a journalist.

  • Able to operate as a team of one: briefing agencies and freelancers and holding them to account, rather than managing staff beneath you.

Preferable experience

  • Experience in a reputation-exposed marketplace, such as pets, dating, gambling, fintech or the gig economy, or in a category under active regulatory or campaigner scrutiny.

  • Experience running consumer surveys with panels or survey tools.

  • Digital PR fundamentals: earned links, newsjacking, syndication.

You will thrive here if you

  • Have the mindset of a hands-on builder rather than a delegator.

  • Believe process serves outcomes, not the other way around.

  • Value clarity, candour and collaboration.

  • Are excited by the challenge of scaling one of Europe's most impactful consumer marketplaces.

What we offer

  • A function that does not exist yet, yours to design, across seven markets, with a proven UK playbook to build from.

  • A proprietary dataset covering millions of pet and horse transactions that no journalist can get anywhere else.

  • Direct access to founders and country leads.

  • A profitable, growing business rather than a slide deck.

  • A diverse team of more than 100 colleagues across the world.

  • Competitive compensation.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Team Lead
jobs.excerpt: DescriptionMetalBear is remote-first, early-stage, and product-led.
jobs.description:
Description

MetalBear is remote-first, early-stage, and product-led. We're building mirrord, a Kubernetes development platform that lets developers and AI coding agents run code against a live cluster before it's deployed.

The problem we solve is the wait. In any organization running microservices, checking whether a change actually works means building an image, pushing it, deploying to a shared environment, and waiting on a pipeline to tell you. That loop runs many times a day per engineer, and it's the single biggest tax on how fast an organization ships. With mirrord, the service runs wherever the work is already happening: on a laptop, in CI, or inside an agent's sandbox. Its traffic, environment variables, and file access are forwarded to and from a shared staging cluster, so the service behaves exactly as it would if it were deployed, without deploying it. Feedback arrives in seconds instead of minutes, against real APIs, real schemas, and real traffic rather than mocks or a hand-maintained local stack.

That matters more every month, because AI agents now write a large share of the code our customers ship. An agent generating code from static files is guessing at how the rest of the system behaves, and a human has to catch the guesses. mirrord gives the agent the real context to write against and a real feedback loop to verify against, so what lands in review is something a reviewer can trust.

mirrord is used by thousands of developers worldwide, including at Fortune 500 companies.

We’re looking for a hands-on engineering leader to lead the Cloud Integrations Team. The Cloud Integrations team owns features that involve automatically managing users’ cloud services (like message brokers, databases, Kubernetes resources and more) to create virtually separate environments with only minimal resource duplication. These are key features that make mirrord uniquely valuable in complex enterprise environments.

﻿What You’ll Do

  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of mirrord’s cloud integration features like queue splitting, DB branching, and more.
  • Stay hands-on and actively contribute to the codebase.
  • Work with Kubernetes, cloud services, DB systems, message brokers, and other tools and platforms.
  • Set the technical direction for the team and maintain high engineering standards.
  • Drive smart, effective use of AI across the team.
  • Help prioritize work, unblock engineers, and drive roadmap execution.
  • Hire and mentor engineers as the team grows.
  • Partner with Product, Solution Engineering and directly with users to drive adoption and expansion.

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience leading engineering teams.
  • At least 4 years of professional experience writing production-grade code in Rust (most preferably), C++, or C.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Understanding of Kubernetes and cloud-native environments.
  • Strong systems-level thinking and an ability to debug complex, distributed environments.
  • Comfortable working async in a remote-first, startup environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building developer tools.
  • Experience building Kubernetes operators or other components that interact with the Kubernetes API.
  • Familiarity with backend infrastructure tooling like data stores, message brokers, GitOps tools, etc.

Why MetalBear?

  • Work on hard, meaningful problems at the intersection of local development and cloud infrastructure.
  • Be part of a small, high-caliber team where your work directly impacts thousands of developers and some of the world’s biggest companies.
  • Work also on an open-source product used and loved by developers.
  • Remote-first, async-friendly, and low on meetings.
  • Competitive salary, stock options, and a culture that respects your time.

​

Serious bonus points if you have:

  • Experience in the legal industry

  • Experience in a hyper-growth environment

This is a new role.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:

The base salary range for this role is R1,776,000 to R2,664,000 ZAR. with on-target earnings (OTE) of R3,552,000 to R5,328,000 at 100% attainment. All Sales roles have a set base/variable pay mix depending on role, and are eligible for uncapped commissions. Variable compensation is not guaranteed and will depend on individual, team, or company performance. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity (DIBE) & Accessibility

Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. We pride ourselves in building and fostering an environment where our teams feel included, valued, and enabled to do the best work of their careers, wherever they choose to log in from. We believe that different perspectives, skills, backgrounds, and experiences result in higher-performing teams and better innovation. We are committed to equal employment and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Clio provides accessibility accommodations during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Learn more about our culture at clio.com/careers

In practice, that means large, high-volume firms where lien density needs to be monitored to protect against fee-structure and profitability risk, and boutique litigation firms managing a smaller number of catastrophic, high-settlement-value cases that demand deep case-level expertise, along with the largest, most complex accounts within our core ICP.

Risk & Complexity Management

Data-Driven Insights & Reporting

  • Generate executive-level reporting and account health dashboards tailored to each firm's leadership.

Customer Onboarding & Training

  • Oversee onboarding for new enterprise accounts, coordinating custom implementation/pilot and training plans that account for larger or more complex firm structures.

Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Serve as the escalation lead across Sales, Marketing, Lien Resolution, Tech, and Finance for enterprise accounts.
  • Partner with other Account Managers on accounts approaching enterprise-level size or complexity, providing segment expertise and a clean handoff.

Event Participation

  • Represent Zipliens at industry events, bar association functions, and conferences that engage senior decision-makers at large and boutique firms.

Organizational Support

  • Contribute account and market insight to ICP, pricing, and retention strategy discussions.
  • Adapt to evolving customer and business needs; contribute feedback to improve enterprise-tier processes.

  • Excellent executive presence and written and verbal communication skills.

jobs.description:
At DuPont, our purpose is to empower the world with essential innovations to thrive. We work on things that matter. Whether it’s providing clean water to more than a billion people on the planet, producing materials that are essential in everyday technology devices from smartphones to electric vehicles, or protecting workers around the world. Discover the many reasons the world’s most talented people are choosing to work at DuPont. Why Join Us | DuPont Careers

Drive Growth in Advanced Industrial Water Treatment

Desalitech, a DuPont business and pioneer in Closed Circuit Reverse Osmosis (CCRO) technology, is seeking a Technical Sales Manager to lead business development and sales growth across the U.S. industrial water market.

This is a high-impact, customer-facing role focused on developing and closing capital equipment opportunities with industrial customers, EPC firms, engineering consultants, and key stakeholders involved in water and wastewater treatment projects.

If you have experience selling industrial water solutions, reverse osmosis systems, process equipment, membrane technologies, or related technical solutions, and enjoy managing complex sales cycles from opportunity identification through contract award, we'd like to hear from you.

Location: Remote, United States
Travel: Up to 50% within assigned territory
Reports To: North American Sales Director – Systems Segment

Why This Opportunity?

  • Fully remote role open to qualified candidates anywhere in the United States

  • Opportunity to represent industry-leading CCRO technology

  • Strong technical and commercial support team

  • Access to pilot systems for customer demonstrations and validation testing

  • Direct exposure to executive leadership and strategic growth initiatives

  • Significant career growth potential within DuPont's global Water Solutions business

What You'll Do

Develop and Win New Business

  • Identify, qualify, and develop new industrial water treatment opportunities

  • Build and execute strategic account plans and opportunity capture plans

  • Prospect for new customers across key industrial markets

  • Develop relationships with decision-makers, engineers, consultants, and procurement teams

  • Lead sales pursuits from initial engagement through contract negotiation and close

Manage Complex Capital Sales Cycles

  • Navigate long-cycle industrial procurement and tendering processes

  • Collaborate with technical experts to develop customer solutions

  • Support pilot demonstrations and technology evaluations

  • Lead proposal development, commercial negotiations, and customer presentations

  • Coordinate internal resources to ensure successful project execution

Grow Strategic Relationships

  • Develop partnerships with EPCs, engineering firms, and industrial end users

  • Represent Desalitech at customer meetings, industry events, and conferences

  • Build market awareness and promote Desalitech's differentiated solutions

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers on water treatment challenges and opportunities

Drive Business Performance

  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and sales forecasting

  • Deliver regular business updates and territory reviews

  • Achieve or exceed bookings, revenue, and growth targets

  • Recommend strategic initiatives to expand market penetration and accelerate growth

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or another technical discipline

  • 5+ years of technical sales, business development, or account management experience within industrial water, wastewater, reverse osmosis, membrane technologies, desalination, or related process industries

  • Proven success selling capital equipment, engineered systems, or technical solutions through complex, long-cycle sales processes

  • Experience working with industrial customers, EPCs, engineering firms, consultants, and procurement teams

  • Demonstrated ability to develop opportunities from prospecting through contract negotiation and close

  • Strong commercial acumen, including pricing strategy, contract negotiations, forecasting, and margin management

  • Ability to travel up to 50%

Preferred

  • Direct experience with reverse osmosis (RO), membrane technologies, water reuse, or advanced water treatment solutions

  • Experience supporting manufacturing, power generation, semiconductor, chemical processing, mining, heavy industry, or other industrial markets

  • MBA or other advanced degree

  • Proven track record of exceeding bookings and revenue targets

  • Experience operating effectively within a matrixed, global organization

What Will Help You Succeed

  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to communicate complex concepts

  • Excellent presentation and customer engagement skills

  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities

  • Self-motivated and comfortable working remotely

  • Strong relationship-building and networking skills

  • Ability to influence stakeholders across technical, operational, and executive levels

What DuPont Offers

  • Competitive base salary and incentive compensation

  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits

  • Retirement and financial planning programs

  • Career advancement opportunities across a global organization

  • Ongoing professional development and learning opportunities

  • Collaborative culture focused on innovation and sustainability

  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on global water and sustainability challenges

Join a team that is helping customers reduce water consumption, improve sustainability, and solve some of the world's most complex industrial water challenges.

Apply today and help shape the future of industrial water treatment.

Join our Talent Community to stay connected with us!

jobs.excerpt: NetWitness has been delivering top-notch Network Forensics, Threat Detection, and Cyber Security Monitoring solutions for more than two decades.
jobs.description:
NetWitness has been delivering top-notch Network Forensics, Threat Detection, and Cyber Security Monitoring solutions for more than two decades. These include NDR, SIEM, UEBA, and SOAR solutions, in addition to best-in-class Incident Response services. We are committed to providing advanced technology and services to help organizations respond to sophisticated cyber threats and secure their networks and critical assets.

Role Overview

This role is for a NetWitness presales consultant based in Europe, with Dutch & English fluency, supporting the Benelux, Nordics, and Eastern Europe territories.

As a Presales Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in driving the adoption of our solutions and services. You will work closely with customers as their trusted advisor, and with the sales team to provide technical expertise and support throughout the sales process. Your deep understanding of our products, services, and the cybersecurity landscape will enable you to effectively address customer needs and demonstrate the value of our solutions. You will also participate and speak at trade shows, seminars, and other marketing events where NetWitness is actively participating.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact throughout the sales cycle.
  • Collaborate with the sales team to develop and execute successful sales strategies.
  • Conduct in-depth technical presentations and product demonstrations, effectively communicating the technical capabilities and business value of the NetWitness solutions.
  • Build and maintain strong technical relationships with key customer stakeholders and be the customer’s trusted advisor.
  • Understand customer's security challenges, technical requirements, and existing infrastructure to propose tailored solutions.
  • Design, deploy, and manage Proof-of-Concepts (POCs) and evaluations, ensuring successful outcomes and demonstrating the effectiveness of the NetWitness solutions.
  • Assist in the creation of technical documentation, proposals, and RFP responses.
  • Deliver health-checks and workshops for existing customers, retaining and expanding their NetWitness footprint.
  • Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of our products, competitive landscape, and industry trends.
  • Stay up to date on the latest cybersecurity threats, attacks, and trends.
  • Work closely with the product management and engineering teams to relay customer feedback, market trends, and contribute to product development.
  • Participate in industry events, trade shows, and conferences to promote our solutions and generate leads.
  • Own and maintain the technical relationship with the NetWitness partners community within the assigned territory.
  • Provide technical training and support to sales team members and partners.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, technical pre-sales, security consulting, or similar roles in the cybersecurity industry.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt and convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • English and Dutch speaker.
  • Deep understanding of networking protocols, network security concepts, and security architectures.
  • Strong knowledge of threat detection methodologies, incident response processes, and common attack vectors.
  • Experience with Threat Detection and Response solutions, such as SIEM, NDR, EDR, UEBA, and SOAR.
  • Proven ability to conduct effective product demonstrations and POCs.
  • Proven track record of supporting successful sales cycles and achieving sales targets.
  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, CEH, SANS, or similar are a plus.
  • Familiarity with Linux CLI and basic scripting/programming skills.
  • Willingness to travel as needed to meet with customers and attend industry events.
  • Team player with a genuine collaborative attitude and willingness to share with and inspire others.

jobs.title: Denials Management Appeals Nurse (Anesthesia)
jobs.excerpt: Company OverviewShriners Children’s is an organization that respects, supports, and values each other.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Shriners Children’s is an organization that respects, supports, and values each other. Named as the 2025 best mid-sized employer by Forbes, we are engaged in providing excellence in patient care, embracing multi-disciplinary education, and research with global impact. We foster a learning environment that values evidenced based practice, experience, innovation, and critical thinking. Our compassion, integrity, accountability, and resilience define us as leaders in pediatric specialty care for our children and their families.

With 20+ hospitals, outpatient clinics, ambulatory care centers and outreach locations across the globe, we provide excellent care to children up to age 18 regardless of their family’s ability to pay or insurance status. Please click here to learn more about our locations.

Job Description

The Denials Management Appeals Nurse (Anesthesia) is responsible for managing our medical denials by conducting a comprehensive analytic review of clinical documentation to determine if an appeal is warranted. The Denials Management Appeals Nurse (Anesthesia) will utilize their clinical background to address the clinical denials, as well as write sound, compelling factual arguments for appealing denials.

The Denials Management Appeals Nurse (Anesthesia) is also responsible for maintaining a detailed knowledge of Third Party Payors and Governmental Payors clinical/medical necessity criteria, as well as filing compliant appeals in accordance with Third party and governmental contracts

Key Responsibilities:

  • Performs a review of assigned cases comparing the bill to the medical record.

  • Performs a detailed comparison of charges to documentation to ensure services documented have been captured through the charge process

  • Performs a detailed comparison of charges to documentation to ensure services not documented are not charged.

  • Reviews documentation to ensure that services typically performed with specific procedures are being documented so that charge capture may occur

  • Review findings with the hospital representatives and obtains an agreement on the discrepancies.

  • Demonstrates tact and understanding in handling problems, has a good rapport with hospital and corporate staffs.

  • Follows up on appeals in a timely fashion to ensure that cases are completed.

  • Re-checks mathematical computations before finalizing letter and report.

  • Updates status of all cases assigned on minimum weekly basis

  • Informs supervisor of any changes, problems, or concerns that arise at a facility.

  • In the event of a dispute with the requesting party’s audit findings, files an appeal with the third party or governmental payor

  • Analyzes and interprets all medical necessity/clinical denials from third party payors or governmental payors.

  • Files appeals based on medical documentation and interpretation of medical necessity guidelines or InterQual criteria.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5 years of clinical healthcare/hospital experience

  • 3 years of related Anesthesia experience

  • Third Party Payor Appeals/Revenue Cycle experience

  • Current RN license in State of employment

  • Working experience with Utilization Review activities and general knowledge of TJC, PRO, and other regulatory bodies.

  • High School Diploma/GED

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree - BSN highly desired

  • Case Management certification

  • Experience reviewing hospital and professional claims, denials and EOB's, appealing claims and working on claims in an audit

  • Experience with Epic, Craneware, Waystar, software and applications

The pay range for this position is $80,912.00 - $121,388.80. Compensation is determined based on years of relevant experience and departmental equity.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Director - Mobility, Industrial, and Advanced Technology
jobs.excerpt: Who we are: We are on a mission to become a leading supplier of critical materials that enable the green energy and technology revolution.
jobs.description:
Who we are:

We are on a mission to become a leading supplier of critical materials that enable the green energy and technology revolution. Our materials and technologies are required for the electric vehicle, green energy, consumer electronics, and defense industries, and our battery grade lithium and tech metals are needed for chipsets, semiconductors, and 5G.

We have a substantial interest in the Round Top, Heavy Rare Earth, Lithium and Critical Minerals deposit in West Texas. We have also developed the United States’ first rare earth and critical minerals processing facility and we own the only scalable, sintered neo-magnet manufacturing system in the Western Hemisphere. By developing this fully integrated, US-based “mine-to-magnet” critical mineral supply chain, we are poised to become the leading domestic supplier to these industries.

What you can expect:

At USA Rare Earth, we are pioneers and problem solvers, technologists and team players. Together, we:

Build Solutions: If our task was a simple one, it would already be done. We are creative and solution-oriented, and we think outside the box to solve important problems. We know that a range of expertise and technologies is needed for success, and we work across sectors and alongside customers to deliver world-class solutions in sustainable ways.

Deliver Quality: When we do things, we do them well. We believe that top-tier quality leads to industry competitiveness and we hold ourselves to the highest quality standards. We move fast when executing, but safety, quality, and excellence always come first.

Lead responsibly: We have a responsibility to the planet, our consumers, our country, and each other. We put safety at the center of all we do, take accountability for our actions, incorporate sustainable practices in our processes and act with the financial best interest of our investors and consumers in mind.

Win Together: Establishing a rare earth magnet supply chain is a big undertaking – and getting there is a team effort. We communicate openly, work together and challenge each other in pursuit of our goals. With every step we take we learn and get better.

Job Summary:

The Sr. Sales Director - Mobility, Industrial, and Advanced Technology leads USA Rare Earth's commercial growth across the mobility, industrial, and advanced technology markets, including automotive and motor manufacturing. This senior role owns an end-to-end book of business, from strategic account planning and new program capture through demand forecasting and year-over-year account growth. The ideal candidate brings deep relationships with OEMs across these markets, understands technical, longer-cycle industrial sales, and operates independently while collaborating closely with Product Management, Engineering, Operations, and other internal leaders to win and grow programs.

Primary Target Markets:

  • Automotive and motor manufacturing
  • Industrial and commercial electric motors
  • Industrial automation and robotics
  • Humanoid robotics and autonomous systems
  • HVAC compressors and motion control systems
  • Factory automation and conveyor systems
  • Material handling and warehouse robotics
  • Other industrial equipment applications
  • Pumps, valves, and fluid control systems

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Sales Leadership & Account Ownership

  • Drive demand generation and close orders with OEM customers across the assigned region.
  • Rapidly build U.S. market position and brand awareness across target verticals.
  • Own and grow an end-to-end book of business across these focus markets, serving as the primary relationship owner for key accounts and target programs.
  • Develop and execute account plans aligned to annual revenue targets.
  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships with customer engineering, procurement, and program management organizations.
  • Guide customers through material qualification and program approval processes, coordinating internal resources to support technical evaluations.
  • Lead development of MOUs, joint development agreements (JDAs), and supply agreements to secure 2026 and beyond volume commitments.
  • Represent USA Rare Earth at tradeshows, conferences, and customer events to build brand presence and generate new opportunities.

Demand Planning & Forecasting

  • Own end-to-end demand planning and forecasting for assigned accounts, coordinating closely with Operations, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing to align production capacity with customer program timelines.
  • Deliver monthly forecasting and demand plans, maintaining forecast accuracy of 80% or greater.
  • Translate customer program schedules, ramp curves, and volume forecasts into actionable production plans.
  • Monitor demand trends across mobility, industrial, and advanced technology markets, including electrification and automation adoption, to inform company-wide planning.

Customer & Pipeline Management (CRM)

  • Maintain rigorous CRM discipline ensuring account, opportunity, and pipeline data reflect current status.
  • Identify and qualify new opportunities, maintaining CRM pipeline coverage of at least 10 times (10x) annual revenue targets.
  • Develop pipeline and convert opportunities into purchase orders.
  • Track and report on pipeline health, win and loss trends, and account growth against annual targets.
  • Develop and maintain multi-year account plans and pursuit roadmaps for strategic customers.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Deal Execution

  • Collaborate with Application Engineering and Product Marketing to align technical solutions with customer needs.
  • Lead contract negotiations, pricing strategy, and commercial terms for new and renewal business.
  • Partner with executive leadership on strategic planning, market entry, and investment prioritization for the segment.

Market Intelligence & Strategy

  • Monitor the competitive landscape, program timelines, and industry trends across automotive, mobility, industrial, and advanced technology markets.
  • Provide voice-of-customer feedback to Product, Engineering, and Leadership to inform roadmap and capacity decisions.
  • Contribute to long-range strategic planning for the segment.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Proven track record of building and growing complex, technical accounts within long sales-cycle industrial markets.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, comfortable engaging with senior customer and internal stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage a full sales cycle, from prospecting through contract negotiation and account growth.
  • Skilled in industrial demand planning and forecasting, with the ability to translate customer programs into production-aligned forecasts.
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms (Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales preferred; Salesforce.com or Hubspot acceptable), with disciplined pipeline management process.
  • Strong collaborator and independent thinker, comfortable operating with autonomy in a fast-paced, growth-stage environment.
  • Working knowledge of automotive, industrial motor, automation, and robotics OEM supply chains.
  • Familiarity with humanoid robotics, factory automation, material handling, and fluid control equipment markets.
  • Understanding of electrification trends, motion control architectures, and automation and robotics actuator technologies.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Engineering or a related field required. MBA or other advanced degree preferred.
  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive commercial or sales experience, including 5+ years focused on mobility, industrial, advanced technology, or an adjacent industry.
  • Demonstrated success managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and growing account revenue year over year.
  • Experience with industrial demand planning and forecasting in a manufacturing or industrial supply environment.
  • Proven CRM proficiency (Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales or Salesforce.com).
  • Existing relationships with automotive, industrial motor, automation, robotics, or related OEM manufacturers strongly preferred.
  • Ability to travel 60% or more to support customer engagements, tradeshows, and other internal meetings.

Physical Demands

The work environment will primarily be a home office or typical office environment, combined with frequent customer-site and travel-related environments. Noise level: normal office noises.

jobs.excerpt: Profile Summary We are seeking a detail-oriented and independent Billing Specialist with experience in invoicing, billing operations, and account reconciliation, ideally within a payroll, PEO, or service-based environment.
jobs.description:
Profile Summary
We are seeking a detail-oriented and independent Billing Specialist with experience in invoicing, billing operations, and account reconciliation, ideally within a payroll, PEO, or service-based environment. The ideal candidate has strong analytical skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage complex billing scenarios while ensuring accuracy and compliance with client agreements. They should be comfortable working remotely with minimal supervision, communicating effectively in English, and collaborating with internal teams and clients to resolve billing inquiries. Experience with payroll-related billing processes is preferred, but training will be provided for the right candidate.

Job Details

Work Setup: Work from home

Work Schedule: Monday-to-Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Central Time

Holidays: To follow U.S. holidays

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare, issue, and send accurate client invoices tied to payroll runs (per-payroll, per-employee, or per-cycle billing models)
  • Manage non-standard, exception-based, and "work-around" billing scenarios tied to payroll activity that fall outside standard system templates — off-cycle payroll runs, correction runs, retroactive pay adjustments, mid-cycle employee additions/terminations, and other one-off billing arrangements
  • Track outstanding invoices and follow up on overdue accounts (collections support)
  • Maintain accurate billing records and client account/employee-count details in the billing system
  • Reconcile billed amounts against client contracts, payroll processing agreements, or service-level terms
  • Process client payments and apply them accurately to the correct invoices/accounts
  • Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies or client billing inquiries related to payroll charges
  • Prepare aging reports and billing status updates for internal review
  • Support month-end billing close and reporting
  • Identify process improvements to increase billing accuracy and efficiency
  • Maintain organized, accurate billing documentation

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field
  • 1–3 years of billing, accounts receivable, or related finance/accounting experience
  • Demonstrated ability to handle non-standard or manual billing situations tied to payroll activity that don't fit a standard invoicing workflow, using sound judgment to resolve them accurately
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Proven ability to work independently and manage time effectively in a remote environment
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and calculations
  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets) for tracking and reporting
  • Reliable internet connection and a dedicated remote workspace

Preferred Qualifications

We're happy to train the right candidate on the items below — prior experience is a plus but not required.

  • Experience with payroll billing models (per-employee, per-payroll-run, or tiered pricing structures)
  • Experience with Prism payroll platform
  • Experience with collections or accounts receivable follow-up
  • Experience working with US-based or international companies
  • Comfortable using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to improve efficiency and accuracy in day-to-day billing work

Preferred Attributes

  • Comfortable working across time zones
  • Self-motivated with strong organizational and follow-up skills
  • Eager to learn and grow within a finance/accounting support role

Orbitwell is an AI-first content workflow that turns a professional's own judgment and stories into a consistent, firm-approved public presence. The platform captures private input through conversation, audio, and dictation, drafts voice-matched content grounded in that person's real expertise, and routes every draft through configurable firm guardrails and human verification before it reaches a ready-to-publish queue. Rather than another point solution for capture, writing, or scheduling, Orbitwell is designed to be the system of record for expert-driven publishing inside professional-services firms.

The venture begins with an initial product, 30+ validation interviews, and a working prototype to accelerate iteration and go-to-market. We are now seeking a founder to lead the venture from here.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception
  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding
  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight’s cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own

  • Customer Development — Expand from internal design partners to external users (creators, teams, agencies), validate retention and willingness to pay, and build the go-to-market motion through creator-led distribution
  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback
  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction
  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

How to Apply
