jobs.excerpt: Run and scale the delivery engine behind a growing technical professional-services and software company.
jobs.description:
Run and scale the delivery engine behind a growing technical professional-services and software company. You will lead a roughly 40-person organization, influence the performance of most company revenue, and partner directly with the CEO on strategy, growth, and acquisition integration. It is a high-impact operating role with a credible path toward broader COO-level responsibility as the business grows.

This confidential company serves public-sector clients nationwide and is expanding organically and through acquisition. It needs a hands-on leader who can bring financial discipline, clear accountability, and a scalable operating cadence without burying a fast-moving, relationship-driven business in bureaucracy.

This is not a back-office role or another layer of project management. You will lead through leaders, own delivery performance, and make the staffing and commercial calls required to improve utilization, contract achievement, quality, and margin. There is no billable target; your capacity is reserved for running the organization.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the CEO and serving on the senior leadership team, you will lead the Delivery/PMO leader and technical Capability Leads across approximately 40 consultants, project managers, and specialists. Because consulting revenue flows through billable delivery, your organization influences roughly 70% of company revenue.

You will own the delivery operating system: capacity, staffing, utilization, hours billed, budgets, contract achievement, scope discipline, quality, escalations, and portfolio margin. You will also help shape company strategy—pricing, staffing mix, investment and cost decisions, annual operating goals, new-business growth, net dollar retention, recurring-revenue mix, and the productization of repeatable offerings.

As future businesses are acquired, you will lead operational integration across systems, staffing, standards, and delivery practices. Broader COO-level scope is a real possibility, although there is no fixed timetable; expanded responsibility will follow demonstrated performance and business need.

What You Will Own

  • Lead and develop the Delivery/PMO leader and Capability Leads through clear goals, 1:1s, performance conversations, and real accountability.
  • Build a trusted cadence for staffing, capacity, delivery reviews, escalations, resource allocation, and portfolio performance.
  • Create visibility into where delivery makes or loses money by project, capability, and person—and act on the findings.
  • Improve utilization, hours billed, budget and contract achievement, scope discipline, quality, and gross margin.
  • Review scopes, budgets, schedules, staffing assumptions, pricing, and complex pursuits before commitments become delivery problems.
  • Make final allocation, people, budget, and scope calls when issues cannot be resolved at the leadership level.
  • Replace recurring workarounds and individual heroics with repeatable practices that scale with revenue and headcount.
  • Serve as executive sponsor for significant accounts and bring senior operating judgment to client, CEO, and business-development conversations.
  • Lead the delivery-side integration of future acquisitions.

What Success Looks Like

  • First quarter: establish command of delivery economics by project, capability, and person; put a working operating cadence in place; and clarify decision rights.
  • Year one: leaders own outcomes at the right level, staffing and capacity reviews run on a rhythm the organization trusts, utilization and margin move for understood reasons, project performance is more visible, and fewer issues require CEO intervention.

What You Bring

You may come from professional services, consulting, managed services, systems integration, cloud or IT services, engineering or architecture services, software-connected services, military leadership, or another project-based operating environment. GIS experience is not required. The exact industry matters less than your ability to lead accountable teams, understand delivery economics, and build operating discipline in a growing company.

Strong candidates typically bring:

  • Substantial operating and leadership experience—often 7+ years—with accountability for teams, leaders, delivery quality, staffing, client outcomes, and financial results.
  • Commercial fluency in utilization, capacity, hours billed, project budgets, scopes, contracts, pricing, gross margin, and staffing tradeoffs.
  • Evidence of building, fixing, scaling, or materially improving a real operating environment with measurable results.
  • Sound judgment under pressure and the ability to make clear decisions with incomplete information.
  • The EQ to earn trust before driving hard changes, plus the ownership mindset to stay hands-on while building systems that reduce fire drills.
  • Credibility with technical professionals and senior clients without needing to be the deepest technical expert in the room.
  • Learning speed, curiosity, and comfort exploring how automation and AI may improve services economics.

Pure strategy experience without hands-on operating ownership is unlikely to be enough.

Helpful Experience

  • Project-based services contracts, scopes, budgets, pricing, and delivery economics.
  • Scaling or restructuring a services organization.
  • M&A integration.
  • Professional-services automation, PSA, resource-management, ERP, or delivery-operations platforms.
  • Public-sector contracting, GIS/geospatial, or technical consulting.
  • MBA or comparable graduate business training.

A bachelor's degree or equivalent professional or military experience is expected; field of study is not a screen.

Compensation and Logistics

  • Base salary: $170,000–$200,000 annually.
  • Performance opportunity: an annual incentive may be offered, with a potential target of approximately $25,000. Terms are not guaranteed and will be confirmed during the offer process.
  • Long-term upside: equity or broader profit participation may become available as scope grows; it is not guaranteed on day one.
  • Benefits: health coverage and a retirement-plan match.
  • Location: remote within the United States, with a preference for candidates in the greater Chicago area.
  • Travel: limited travel as needed, especially early in the role.
  • Status: full-time, exempt.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionMetalBear is remote-first, early-stage, and product-led.
jobs.description:
Description

MetalBear is remote-first, early-stage, and product-led. We're building mirrord, a Kubernetes development platform that lets developers and AI coding agents run code against a live cluster before it's deployed.

The problem we solve is the wait. In any organization running microservices, checking whether a change actually works means building an image, pushing it, deploying to a shared environment, and waiting on a pipeline to tell you. That loop runs many times a day per engineer, and it's the single biggest tax on how fast an organization ships. With mirrord, the service runs wherever the work is already happening: on a laptop, in CI, or inside an agent's sandbox. Its traffic, environment variables, and file access are forwarded to and from a shared staging cluster, so the service behaves exactly as it would if it were deployed, without deploying it. Feedback arrives in seconds instead of minutes, against real APIs, real schemas, and real traffic rather than mocks or a hand-maintained local stack.

That matters more every month, because AI agents now write a large share of the code our customers ship. An agent generating code from static files is guessing at how the rest of the system behaves, and a human has to catch the guesses. mirrord gives the agent the real context to write against and a real feedback loop to verify against, so what lands in review is something a reviewer can trust.

mirrord is used by thousands of developers worldwide, including at Fortune 500 companies.

We’re looking for a hands-on engineering leader to lead the Cloud Integrations Team. The Cloud Integrations team owns features that involve automatically managing users’ cloud services (like message brokers, databases, Kubernetes resources and more) to create virtually separate environments with only minimal resource duplication. These are key features that make mirrord uniquely valuable in complex enterprise environments.

﻿What You’ll Do

  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of mirrord’s cloud integration features like queue splitting, DB branching, and more.
  • Stay hands-on and actively contribute to the codebase.
  • Work with Kubernetes, cloud services, DB systems, message brokers, and other tools and platforms.
  • Set the technical direction for the team and maintain high engineering standards.

Requirements

  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Understanding of Kubernetes and cloud-native environments.
  • Strong systems-level thinking and an ability to debug complex, distributed environments.
  • Comfortable working async in a remote-first, startup environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building developer tools.
  • Experience building Kubernetes operators or other components that interact with the Kubernetes API.
  • Familiarity with backend infrastructure tooling like data stores, message brokers, GitOps tools, etc.

Why MetalBear?

  • Work on hard, meaningful problems at the intersection of local development and cloud infrastructure.
  • Be part of a small, high-caliber team where your work directly impacts thousands of developers and some of the world’s biggest companies.
  • Work also on an open-source product used and loved by developers.

jobs.excerpt: Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators.
jobs.description:
Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people-centered strategy has defined us — and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide.

Our mission to transform lives is made possible by talented people who bring diverse industry experience, backgrounds and skills to the university. And today, we're ready to expand our reach. All we need is you.

Make an impact — from near or far

At SNHU, you'll have the option to work remotely in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.

We ask that our remote employees have access to a reliable internet connection and a dedicated, properly equipped workspace that is free of distractions. Employees must reside in, and work from, one of the above approved states.

The opportunity

The Service Desk Operations Manager is a senior leader responsible for end-to-end IT Service Desk operations, ensuring consistent, high-quality service delivery through internal teams and managed service partners.

In this role, you will own contractual service-level performance, reporting and analytics, incident management, including coordination of major incident response, and monitoring of operational process execution. You will serve as a strategic leader and a hands-on operational manager. Additionally, you will oversee technical platform requirements, testing, and delivery for the IT Service Desk team.

You will ensure service desk and business operations functions, including incident management, service requests, and support services, are delivered in alignment with service level agreements (SLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and customer experience expectations. You will also drive continuous improvements through process optimization and data-driven decision-making. You will report to the Assistant Vice President ITS Service Desk & Support Operations.

What you'll do:

Leadership & Service Desk Operations

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of service desk professionals, driving accountability, performance, and engagement
  • Own day-to-day operations, including queue health, ticket management, prioritization, and workload balancing
  • Be an a hands-on leader, actively engaging in escalations, incident response, and operational decision-making

Contractual Service Level Management

  • Own and govern Service Level Management (SLM) processes for the managed service partner and internal operations
  • Monitor SLA/KPI performance (response, resolution, backlog, CSAT) and drive corrective actions to meet established contractual obligations
  • Drive operational adjustments, process changes, and prioritization decisions to consistently meet or exceed service targets

Reporting & Analytics

  • Develop and maintain operational dashboards and reporting frameworks leveraging ServiceNow, Five9, and related tools with strong collaboration with Platform Owners to align Service Desk requirements and tool capabilities
  • Translate data into insights that inform staffing, service design, and operational improvements
  • Analyze trends in volume, SLA adherence, incident patterns, and customer feedback to proactively manage performance
  • Establish a strong data-driven operating model, enabling leadership visibility into service health and risks
  • Deliver regular reporting to leadership on performance outcomes, trends, and improvement opportunities

Incident Control & Escalation Management

  • Provide leadership oversight for incident management, escalation handling, and major incident response
  • Be a senior escalation point to ensure timely restoration and communication during service disruptions
  • Ensure adherence to incident prioritization, routing, and escalation standards aligned to ITIL practices
  • Oversee operational controls related to ticket flow, backlog management, and queue governance

Process Execution Monitoring & Optimization

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across Service Desk operations
  • Serve as Process Repository Owner, ensuring documentation standards, governance, and lifecycle management
  • Monitor process execution and adherence, ensuring consistency across Service Desk operations
  • Identify inefficiencies and drive process optimization and standardization
  • Establish and enforce change control and communication practices for process updates

Partnerships

  • Maintain an operational leadership role in management of the IT Service Desk managed services provider
  • Partner closely with Service Experience Owners to translate quality insights into process, technology, and training improvements
  • Partner with Knowledge Enablement to ensure training programs align to operational needs, performance trends, and service changes
  • Partner with Platform and Process Owners to align engagement and interaction in Service Desk escalation processes
  • Integrate training strategies with quality findings, process updates, and new technology implementations
  • Other responsibilities as assigned

What we're looking for:

  • 10 years of relevant experience in business process ownership, documenting, executing or automating
  • 1 year of experience leading teams and operational functions in a complex service environment
  • Advanced knowledge of service workflows, and support models
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field or equivalent of experience in lieu of degree
  • Experience managing service delivery in large, complex environments, including managed service providers
  • Strong track record in SLA management, reporting & analytics (Service Now or Power BI), and operational performance improvement
  • Experience improving processes and driving efficiency such as through LEAN methodologies.

We believe real innovation comes from inclusion - where different experiences, perspectives and talents are celebrated. So if you're wondering whether SNHU is right for you, take the leap and apply. You might be just the person we're looking for.

Compensation

The annual pay range for this position is $85,563.00 - $136,928.00. Actual offer will be based on skills, qualifications, experience and internal equity, in addition to relevant business considerations. We expect this position to be hired in the following target hiring range $94,548.00 - $127,918.00.

Exceptional benefits (because you’re exceptional)

You’re the whole package. Your benefits should be, too. As a full-time employee at SNHU, you’ll get:

  • High-quality, low-deductible medical insurance

  • Low to no-cost dental and vision plans

  • 5 weeks of paid time off (plus almost a dozen paid holidays)

  • Employer-funded retirement

  • Free tuition program

  • Parental leave

jobs.description:
Location: Europe. Being in the UK, Germany or Sweden is a small plus for market proximity and occasional travel, but it is not a requirement.

About Pet Media Group

Pet Media Group (PMG) is a scale-up that acquires, launches and develops market-leading pet and equestrian marketplaces globally. We operate eight brands across seven markets in the UK, US, Germany, Sweden, the Netherlands, Italy and Spain. Every year, 1.7 million pets and horses find a new home through our platforms, and some of our flagship platforms include Pets4Homes.co.uk, Deine-Tierwelt.de and Lancasterpuppies.com.

The pet rehoming experience has remained largely unchanged for decades. At PMG, we are on a mission to transform this process by making it more trusted, safe and convenient through innovative technology. We are a driven and ambitious team with a track record of building unicorns, backed by top-tier investors such as Verdane. As a company, we have been profitable since our first year, meaning we do not rely on investor capital for our growth.

The opportunity

This is our first dedicated PR hire and it covers the whole group. Over the years, PMG has managed to reduce animal welfare issues on our platforms far below any peer, through ID verification of breeders, AI-assisted moderation of adverts, a zero-tolerance approach to illegal puppy imports and unlicensed high-volume breeding, and by going far beyond what the law requires. Your job is to tell the world about it.

We know the playbook works because we have already done it once. In the UK, we have changed the public conversation about Pets4Homes from risky classifieds to the most trusted and responsible way to find a pet. Our annual Pet Industry Report is now a fixture in the national press and TV. The challenge is doing that in more than one market at a time.

That is the job: take a proven single-market playbook and make it run in seven, as one person backed by AI tools and outside help where needed, rather than a department.

Your edge is finding the story inside the data and knowing exactly which angle will make a journalist stop scrolling. You bring an AI-forward mindset, the instinct to ask how can I leverage myself through AI, and you use it daily for data analysis, drafting, localising, and getting a story out across markets, so covering seven markets does not mean seven times the work.

What you will do

  • Turn our marketplace data into publishable stories: pricing and demand trends, breed rankings, most popular puppy names, buyer surveys on preferences and the like. One shared instrument based on real-time data and identical core survey questions across markets.

  • Build and run the group editorial calendar, planned per market around seasonal hooks such as heatwaves, fireworks, International Puppy Day and so on, so we are ready before the news cycle asks.

  • Own our trust and safety transparency reporting: listings blocked, scams intercepted, buyer money protected, illegal import patterns by origin, for distribution to journalists and animal welfare stakeholders alike.

  • Mine breeder reviews, Trustpilot and support conversations for the human stories regional press actually run.

  • Become PMG's press desk, so the journalist relationship belongs to PMG rather than to an agency.

  • Brief and equip country leads and founders as spokespeople: talking points, Q&A, data appendices, prep before interviews.

Requirements

Must-have experience

  • 5+ years in PR, communications or journalism, preferably in-house, with coverage in national or major regional media that you personally landed. Data journalism experience is a strong plus.

  • A track record of building stories out of data rather than distributing press releases. You can spot the angle a journalist will want before they ask, and you are comfortable enough with spreadsheets and dashboards to find it yourself and sanity check a number before a reporter does.

  • Daily, active use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT for research, drafting, localisation and workflow automation. You think in terms of how to leverage yourself through AI, not around it, with a clear view of what to automate and what stays human.

  • Native-level English, written to a standard that needs no editing before it reaches a journalist.

  • Able to operate as a team of one: briefing agencies and freelancers and holding them to account, rather than managing staff beneath you.

Preferable experience

  • Experience in a reputation-exposed marketplace, such as pets, dating, gambling, fintech or the gig economy, or in a category under active regulatory or campaigner scrutiny.

  • Experience running consumer surveys with panels or survey tools.

  • Digital PR fundamentals: earned links, newsjacking, syndication.

You will thrive here if you

  • Have the mindset of a hands-on builder rather than a delegator.

  • Believe process serves outcomes, not the other way around.

  • Value clarity, candour and collaboration.

  • Are excited by the challenge of scaling one of Europe's most impactful consumer marketplaces.

What we offer

  • A function that does not exist yet, yours to design, across seven markets, with a proven UK playbook to build from.

  • A proprietary dataset covering millions of pet and horse transactions that no journalist can get anywhere else.

  • Direct access to founders and country leads.

  • A profitable, growing business rather than a slide deck.

  • A diverse team of more than 100 colleagues across the world.

  • Competitive compensation.

THE COMMERCIAL PROJECT CONTROLS & COORDINATION MANAGER

SunStrong Management is seeking a remote Commercial Project Controls & Coordination Manager. SunStrong delivers technical asset management and operations for a renewable portfolio spanning solar, battery energy storage, wind, and EV infrastructure. Project Delivery reports into Commercial Operations by design: the organization that will operate an asset for thirty years controls the standard by which it is accepted at twelve months.
The Manager of Project Controls & Coordination owns the integrity of the information the delivery organization runs on — schedule, cost, change, contract terms — and the operating discipline of the registers that trace every commitment and every open item to closure. The role is the reason a gate decision can be made on evidence rather than on a contractor's summary.
The role deliberately combines two distinct bodies of work: an analytical function that independently baselines, recalculates, and reports variance, and a coordination function that maintains the registers, the document vault, and the meeting and reporting cadence. This is a single role by design at current portfolio scale, with a defined trigger for splitting it. The candidate profile is analytical first — coordination discipline can be taught to an analyst; analytical judgment cannot be taught to a coordinator.COMMERCIAL PROJECT CONTROLS & COORDINATION MANAGER RESPONSIBILITIES

Analytical — Schedule Control

  • Establish and maintain the integrated project schedule baseline; control all baseline changes through a documented change process.
  • Review EPC-submitted schedules for logic integrity — open ends, constraints, negative float, excessive lags, and critical path credibility. A schedule accepted without interrogation is a schedule written for the contractor.
  • Maintain the portfolio milestone and gate forecast; identify projected slip against COD, lender, tax equity, and host commitments early enough that it is a decision rather than an emergency.
  • Perform schedule variance and trend analysis; distinguish recoverable slip from structural slip and state which is which.
  • Verify that three-week lookaheads reconcile to the master schedule rather than describing a parallel reality.

Analytical — Cost Control

  • Own the project cost baseline, commitment tracking, actual cost capture, and cost-to-complete forecasting.
  • Maintain earned value methodology across the portfolio; report SPI, CPI, and forecast at completion with a stated basis.
  • Review EPC payment applications against verified physical progress, milestone achievement, and retainage terms before release.
  • Maintain the retainage and punchlist hold register, including SSM independent cost estimates supporting Category B and C holds.
  • Support capital forecasting and cash flow projection with Finance and Asset Management.

Analytical — Change Control

  • Own the change order log from request through disposition, with schedule and cost impact independently assessed rather than accepted as submitted.
  • Analyze each change against the contracted scope to determine whether it is genuine added scope, a scope gap the EPC should have caught, or a contractor estimating error.
  • Track cumulative change against delegated authority thresholds and flag approaching limits before they are exceeded.
  • Maintain change trend analysis by contractor as a direct input to the EPC performance scorecard.

Analytical — Contract Abstraction

  • Abstract every EPC agreement into the standard term register within fifteen business days of intake — completion definitions, performance guarantees, testing methodology, liquidated damages, retainage, warranty, notice requirements, and change authority.
  • Identify and log Baseline Exposures where the contract as written falls short of the SSM acceptance standard; assign owners and track mitigation.
  • Maintain the warranty register with expiration tracking and claim window alerting. A claim window that closes unnoticed is a direct loss and is treated as one.
  • Maintain the delivery risk register with quantified exposure and mitigation status.

Coordination — Registers and Document Control

  • Own the punchlist register system — structure, field standards, data integrity, aging reporting, and completeness of closure evidence across all projects.
  • Maintain register hygiene: no orphaned IDs, no renumbering, no items closed without a verifier and an evidence reference.
  • Drive aging follow-up across punchlist, RFI, submittal, and nonconformance logs; escalate items breaching aging thresholds rather than reporting them indefinitely.
  • Own the project document vault — filing standard, naming convention, version control, access control.
  • Maintain the equipment register — serial numbers, network addresses, warranty start dates — as construction data lands.

Coordination — Cadence and Reporting Production

  • Produce the monthly owner project review package and the weekly gate and variance reporting.
  • Coordinate the weekly internal delivery standup and the monthly owner project review — agenda, materials, actions, and action closure.
  • Track action items from all delivery forums to closure with named owners and dates.
  • Support lender, tax equity, and host milestone certification with defensible documentation.

Systems and Data Standards

  • Define and enforce data standards — naming conventions, site codes, equipment tags, WBS structure — so that delivery data reconciles to operations data after turnover rather than requiring a manual crosswalk.
  • Build and maintain reporting tooling and dashboards that surface exceptions rather than requiring the reader to hunt for them.
  • Automate recurring coordination tasks. Every hour automated is an hour returned to analysis.
  • Build durable tooling within the constraints of the actual environment, including SharePoint limitations, rather than solutions that depend on software SSM does not have.



MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
  • Five or more years in project controls, cost engineering, or scheduling within construction, energy, or infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated ownership of schedule baselines and earned value reporting on capital projects.
  • Working command of EPC contract commercial terms and their controls implications — milestone payment, retainage, liquidated damages, and change authority.
  • Advanced Excel; scheduling software proficiency (Primavera P6 or MS Project).
  • Demonstrated ability to report an unfavorable variance accurately to the person whose project it is.
  • Willingness to perform coordination and document control work personally at current scale. This role builds the function before it supervises one.
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, finance, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.



Preferred Qualifications
  • Solar PV or BESS construction controls experience.
  • AACE International certification — PSP, CCP, or EVP.
  • Power BI, SQL, Power Automate, or Python for reporting automation.
  • Experience building durable tooling inside SharePoint-constrained environments.
  • Experience standing up a controls function rather than inheriting one.

.
Benefits
SunStrong Management offers a rich and affordable Health & Wellness Benefits package that includes:
  • PPO and HDHP Medical Plans, buy-up plans for both Dental and Vision, ancillaries such as Accident, Critical illness, Hospital indemnity, Employer sponsored Short Term and Long-Term Disability, Voluntary Life, and Legal services along with multiple add-ons.
  • Our 401(k) Package includes a Safe Harbor Match of 100% up to the first 4% and 50% on the next 2% with immediate vesting.

jobs.description:
Location: Remote (United States)

Work Model: Remote

Industry: AI recruiting and talent marketplace (B2B SaaS)

Compensation: $20–$35 per hour

About the Company

TalentPluto is a Y Combinator-backed startup building the hiring stack for high-growth companies. We run two connected products: a talent network that places engineering, go-to-market, and operations people into fast-moving startups, and an AI recruiting tool that lets a hiring team run candidate search, tiered enrichment, rubric-based scoring, and outbound campaigns directly from their assistant. We work with dozens of venture-backed startups across AI, developer tools, fintech, and healthcare. The team is small and founder-led, and interns work on live problems rather than practice ones.

The Opportunity

This is a marketing analyst internship that sits between the data and the decision. We generate a lot of signal across outbound, inbound, content, and the product itself, and most of it goes unread. Your job is to find the pattern in it, explain what it means in plain language, and then help act on it. The analysis is only half the role: the other half is that someone changes what they do because of what you found.

You will work close to the growth function at an early-stage company, which means the questions are open rather than assigned. Expect to spend time in spreadsheets, to have to define a metric before you can report it, and to write up what you learned so it survives past the week you learned it.

Responsibilities

  • Pull, clean, and analyze data across marketing, outbound, and product usage.
  • Identify patterns and anomalies, and explain what is causing them in plain language.
  • Build and maintain simple reporting that the team actually reads and uses.
  • Define and document metrics so numbers mean the same thing week to week.
  • Turn findings into concrete recommendations, and help implement the ones that get picked up.

Requirements

  • Comfort with spreadsheets and basic data analysis.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to spot patterns in data.
  • Clear written communication, including explaining an insight simply to a non-analyst.
  • Interest in marketing, growth, analytics, startups, recruiting, or AI products.
  • Organized and comfortable working across several projects at once.
  • Self-directed and comfortable working in a remote startup environment.

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer who combines strong hands-on development expertise with a passion for building scalable, modern SaaS products. In this role, you will contribute to core product capabilities, influence architecture and engineering standards, and help deliver innovative AI-enabled experiences for our customers. You will work across the application stack, partnering closely with engineering, product, and UX teams to develop high-quality solutions that are secure, scalable, and maintainable. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy solving complex technical challenges, mentoring others, and helping teams adopt modern development practices that improve both quality and delivery velocity.

Responsibilities

  • Develop high-quality product features using modern web technologies and engineering best practices.
  • Design, build, and maintain both frontend and backend application components, APIs, and services.
  • Help define and evolve application architecture, design patterns, and engineering standards across the platform.
  • Contribute to the continued growth and evolution of a multi-tenant SaaS platform with a focus on scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability.
  • Build and integrate AI-enabled features, workflows, and user experiences that provide meaningful value to customers.
  • Collaborate with technical leadership on system design, architectural decisions, and long-term platform strategy.
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and engineering initiatives that improve quality, testing, automation, and delivery processes.
  • Promote modern development practices, including AI-assisted development workflows, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Mentor and support fellow engineers through technical guidance, collaboration, and knowledge sharing.
  • Partner closely with Product, UX, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver well-designed, customer-focused solutions.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend practical solutions that enhance product quality, developer productivity, and customer experience.

Required Qualifications

Core Technical Strengths

  • Strong experience building modern web applications using contemporary frontend frameworks and technologies.
  • Advanced knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript and modern software development practices.
  • Experience designing and developing APIs and backend services.
  • Experience working with cloud-based application environments and deployment pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of application architecture, software design patterns, and scalable engineering principles.
  • Experience working in collaborative development environments with source control, code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD practices.

AI-Enabled Product Development

  • Experience integrating AI services or AI-enabled capabilities into modern applications, or demonstrated ability to rapidly develop expertise in this area.
  • Familiarity with LLMs and modern AI integration patterns.
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, vector search, tool use, and AI orchestration.
  • Understanding of the reliability, security, privacy, governance, and user-experience considerations associated with AI-enabled applications.
  • Interest in using AI-assisted development tools and workflows to improve engineering productivity.

Engineering Leadership & Architecture

  • Demonstrated ability to influence application architecture and engineering standards.
  • Experience designing scalable, maintainable solutions within SaaS environments.
  • Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, security principles, and multi-tenant application patterns.
  • Ability to balance long-term technical excellence with pragmatic business and delivery goals.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and helping elevate team-wide development practices.

Modern Web Engineering Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of component-based architecture and separation of concerns.
  • Experience building accessible, performant, and responsive web applications.
  • Familiarity with modern data-fetching, state management, routing, and application architecture patterns.
  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools and modern engineering workflows to improve productivity, quality, and consistency.
  • Familiarity with specification-driven development approaches, automation, and quality-focused engineering practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in SaaS or multi-tenant application environments.
  • Experience with cloud-native architectures and modern infrastructure platforms.
  • Experience shipping AI-enabled functionality in a production SaaS environment.
  • Familiarity with data-intensive applications, analytics platforms, or business intelligence solutions.
  • Experience with design systems or reusable component libraries.
  • Exposure to AI platforms, intelligent workflows, or agent-based solutions.

What Success Looks Like

  • You help deliver reliable, scalable, and high-quality features that create meaningful customer value.
  • You contribute to architectural decisions that improve the long-term health and scalability of the platform.
  • You champion modern engineering practices that improve quality, consistency, and team effectiveness.
  • You help establish patterns and standards that enable the platform and engineering organization to grow successfully.
  • You mentor teammates and contribute to a culture of collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence.
  • You build solutions that others can confidently extend and maintain.

PLEASE NOTE:

  • This role will work in the Eastern Time Zone.
  • Limited travel. Generally fewer than five trips per year for in-person team, planning, or company meetings.
  • This role is posted as remote, but it could be hybrid or in-office if that best fits your working style.
  • This role is ONLY available for work in the following (24) locations: AL, AR, CO, FL, IL, IN, KY, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, NC, NH, NJ, PA, SC, TX, VA, VT, WA, WI, WV, & DC.

If you don't meet all the requirements mentioned above, don't worry. We strongly believe in creating a diverse and inclusive work environment. If you find this job opportunity interesting but don't meet all the qualifications listed in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect candidate for this role or similar roles.

Who We Are:

ROI Solutions was founded in 1999 to help nonprofit organizations change the world through innovative technology solutions and services. We are focused on sustainable growth, hiring staff committed to working with the nonprofit sector, and constantly evolving our technology and services to help nonprofits succeed in their missions with passion and purpose. This is our calling. We’re a proudly independent company, meaning we answer only to our clients rather than shareholders and investors. Our clients inspire our product and solution roadmaps, as well as our strategic direction. We’re committed to this model and the opportunity it provides us to develop our solutions based on needs in the nonprofit sector.

We are a proud equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic as established by law.

Le candidat Idéal

jobs.excerpt: Job Description A bit about this role:The Pharmacy Fraud Program Manager is a member of the Special Investigations Unit responsible for detecting, validating, and investigating suspected fraudulent activity within the pharmacy benefit — including prescribing, dispensing, and pharmacy claims activity — across a wide range of internal and external data sources.
jobs.description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:

The Pharmacy Fraud Program Manager is a member of the Special Investigations Unit responsible for detecting, validating, and investigating suspected fraudulent activity within the pharmacy benefit — including prescribing, dispensing, and pharmacy claims activity — across a wide range of internal and external data sources. This role centers on rigorous data validation — reconciling, cross-referencing, and stress-testing information drawn from numerous systems to confirm accuracy, surface inconsistencies, and build defensible investigative findings.

The ideal candidate pairs a deeply inquisitive, investigative mindset with strong analytical discipline and brings genuine pharmacy depth: fluency with pharmacy claims data and pharmacy benefit operations, including NCPDP claim fields, NDCs, quantity and days supply logic, formulary and prior authorization concepts, and prescriber and pharmacy identifiers (NPI, DEA, state license), together with a working knowledge of the regulatory framework governing pharmacy fraud, waste, and abuse.

They are fluent in recognizing pharmacy fraud triggers and red flags — prescribing and dispensing outliers, controlled substance and overutilization patterns, and pharmacy billing schemes — and they actively leverage AI-assisted detection and validation tools to scale their analysis, prioritize cases, and reduce false positives. This person is comfortable asking hard questions, following the data wherever it leads, and translating complex findings into clear, actionable conclusions.

In addition to the core responsibilities of the Fraud Program Manager role, this position serves as the primary owner of the CFWA relationship with our pharmacy benefit manager, coordinating referrals, reporting, and oversight activities between the organization and CVS. This person will work side by side with the Fraud Program Manager on overall fraud detection and scheme identification.

Your responsibilities and impact will include:

CFWA Relationship Management — CVS

  • Serve as the primary point of contact and relationship owner for the CFWA program with CVS, managing day-to-day coordination, escalations, and information exchange.

  • Manage the intake, routing, and disposition of CFWA referrals to and from CVS, tracking each referral through resolution and ensuring turnaround times and documentation standards are met.

  • Lead recurring CFWA governance touchpoints (e.g., joint operating and workgroup meetings), setting agendas, tracking action items, and driving issues to closure.

  • Review CVS-provided FWA reporting, investigative summaries, audit results, and recovery activity for completeness, accuracy, and consistency with source claims data; challenge findings that are not supported by the data.

  • Monitor CVS performance against contractual, delegated, and regulatory FWA obligations; identify gaps, request corrective action, and escalate deficiencies to compliance and leadership.

  • Track pharmacy-level actions performed by CVS under the PBM agreement — including pharmacy audits, prepayment review, claim edits, recoveries, and network termination — confirming that agreed actions were taken and applied correctly, and escalating where they were not.

Data Validation & Source Reconciliation

  • Validate, reconcile, and cross-reference data drawn from numerous and disparate sources — pharmacy and medical claims systems, PBM data feeds, prior authorization and rejected-claim data, eligibility and enrollment systems, prescriber and pharmacy provider files, third-party databases, public records, watchlists, internal applications, and external vendor feeds.

  • Identify discrepancies, anomalies, and inconsistencies across data sets — including NDC, quantity, days supply, DAW, prescriber NPI, DEA number, and dispensing pharmacy mismatches — and determine whether they indicate error, manipulation, or fraud.

  • Establish and maintain data integrity standards for investigations, ensuring findings are accurate, complete, and defensible.

  • Trace data lineage across internal systems and PBM-supplied files, corroborating information against authoritative sources to confirm or refute investigative hypotheses.

AI-Assisted Detection & Validation

  • Use AI- and machine learning–driven detection tools to flag suspicious patterns, score risk, and surface high-priority cases for review.

  • Validate AI-generated alerts and model outputs against source claims and clinical data, distinguishing genuine fraud indicators from false positives, data artifacts, and legitimate clinical variation.

  • Provide structured feedback to analytics, vendor, and PBM partners to improve model accuracy, tuning, and rule logic over time.

  • Stay current on emerging AI-enabled fraud schemes (e.g., synthetic identities, deepfakes, generated prescriptions or prior authorization documentation, fraudulent e-prescribing credentials) and adapt detection approaches accordingly.

Pharmacy Fraud Detection, Triggers & Red Flags

  • Apply deep knowledge of pharmacy fraud triggers, red flags, and typologies — including prescribing and dispensing patterns — to proactively identify suspicious activity before it escalates.

  • Develop, refine, and document indicators and detection criteria based on emerging schemes and investigative learnings.

  • Investigate referrals and self-sourced leads, building complete case referrals supported by validated evidence.

Case Referrals

  • Conduct thorough data validation into suspected fraudulent activity, documenting methodology, findings, and conclusions.

  • Maintain accurate, audit-ready case records in the case management system.

  • Prepare clear written summaries and present findings to leadership, business partners, legal, and, when appropriate, law enforcement or regulatory bodies.

Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Partner with claims, payment integrity, underwriting, compliance, legal, and data teams — as well as pharmacy operations and clinical and pharmacy services — to share intelligence and strengthen controls.

  • Work and collaborate with the Fraud Program Manager on overall fraud detection and scheme identification.

  • Mentor junior analysts on data validation techniques, investigative methodology, and red-flag recognition.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of SIU processes, tools, and detection capabilities.

Required skills and experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Criminal Justice, Finance, Data Analytics, Health Administration, Pharmacy, Business, or a related field — or equivalent investigative experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in fraud investigation, financial crime, pharmacy benefit or claims analysis, or a closely related field, ideally within an SIU or comparable environment.

Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We operate across 3 business segments:

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Requirements

Mission of the role
To deliver accurate, timely, and compliant bookkeeping for a diverse portfolio of UK clients (VAT and non-VAT). Reporting to the Senior Accountant feeding into the Accounts Manager, this role ensures all financial records are consistently up-to-date, hitting critical deadlines while providing high-quality support to the wider accounting team.

Key outcomes in the first 6–12 months

  • Outcome 1: Maintain Flawless Xero Records — Ensure all client transactions are fully recorded, allocated, and perfectly reconciled in Xero within target deadlines.
  • Outcome 2: Build Client Relationships — Establish strong, trusting relationships with your client portfolio, ensuring smooth communication and the timely collection of required financial documents.
  • Outcome 3: Support the Accounts Team — Seamlessly integrate with the UK team, reliably assisting the Senior Accountant and Accounting Manager to ensure all departmental targets and statutory deadlines are met.
  • Outcome 4: Drive Bookkeeping Efficiency — Identify process bottlenecks and proactively implement smarter ways of working to increase efficiency and speed across your portfolio's bookkeeping workflows.

Must-have experience

  • UK Tax & Compliance: Proven track record handling both VAT returns and non-VAT registered clients.
  • Multi-Industry Exposure: Broad bookkeeping experience across a wide variety of business sectors.
  • E-commerce Expertise: Specific, demonstrable experience managing the complexities of e-commerce bookkeeping (e.g., handling payment gateways, multi-channel sales, inventory).
  • Language Proficiency: Exceptional, grammatically correct written and spoken English (essential for an overseas hire managing direct UK client communications).
  • Software: Strong proficiency in Xero.

Must-have attributes

  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: Spots errors instantly and takes pride in 100% accurate data entry and reconciliations.
  • Highly Organized & Deadline-Driven: Capable of juggling multiple clients at once without letting turnaround times slip.
  • Proactive & Self-Motivated: Because this is an overseas role, they must be a self-starter who doesn't need to be micro-managed to get the work done.
  • Adaptable: Quick to learn and comfortable switching gears between completely different industries (e.g., jumping from an e-commerce client to a construction client).
  • Clear Communicator: Confident enough to ask the right questions when information is missing, and polite but firm when chasing clients for paperwork.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

  • Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.
  • Humility: There is so much we don't know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.
  • Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you're more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.
  • Attention to detail: You'll be managing multiple, complex workstreams from numerous stakeholders. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing or inconsistent.
  • Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn't their first language. For you to excel, you'll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

The interview process

  • TA Screening Call: A 30 minute call with our Talent Acquisition team
  • Live Technical Assessment: A ~60–90 minute live skills test to assess your hands-on bookkeeping capability.
  • Soft Skills Interview: A ~15-30 minute interview with the hiring team to evaluate real-world work scenarios against our core behavioural values.
  • Reference Verification: Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

Requirement for background screening Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role. This may include using external vendors to verify:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation. By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at Sleek.com.

Benefits

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility: You'll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don't mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year.

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: You'll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you'll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There's also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We're also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we've been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we've joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

Location: Europe. Being in the UK, Germany or Sweden is a small plus for market proximity and occasional travel, but it is not a requirement.

About Pet Media Group

Pet Media Group (PMG) is a scale-up that acquires, launches and develops market-leading pet and equestrian marketplaces globally. We operate eight brands across seven markets in the UK, US, Germany, Sweden, the Netherlands, Italy and Spain. Every year, 1.7 million pets and horses find a new home through our platforms, and some of our flagship platforms include Pets4Homes.co.uk, Deine-Tierwelt.de and Lancasterpuppies.com.

The pet rehoming experience has remained largely unchanged for decades. At PMG, we are on a mission to transform this process by making it more trusted, safe and convenient through innovative technology. We are a driven and ambitious team with a track record of building unicorns, backed by top-tier investors such as Verdane. As a company, we have been profitable since our first year, meaning we do not rely on investor capital for our growth.

The opportunity

This is our first dedicated PR hire and it covers the whole group. Over the years, PMG has managed to reduce animal welfare issues on our platforms far below any peer, through ID verification of breeders, AI-assisted moderation of adverts, a zero-tolerance approach to illegal puppy imports and unlicensed high-volume breeding, and by going far beyond what the law requires. Your job is to tell the world about it.

We know the playbook works because we have already done it once. In the UK, we have changed the public conversation about Pets4Homes from risky classifieds to the most trusted and responsible way to find a pet. Our annual Pet Industry Report is now a fixture in the national press and TV. The challenge is doing that in more than one market at a time.

That is the job: take a proven single-market playbook and make it run in seven, as one person backed by AI tools and outside help where needed, rather than a department.

Your edge is finding the story inside the data and knowing exactly which angle will make a journalist stop scrolling. You bring an AI-forward mindset, the instinct to ask how can I leverage myself through AI, and you use it daily for data analysis, drafting, localising, and getting a story out across markets, so covering seven markets does not mean seven times the work.

What you will do

  • Turn our marketplace data into publishable stories: pricing and demand trends, breed rankings, most popular puppy names, buyer surveys on preferences and the like. One shared instrument based on real-time data and identical core survey questions across markets.

  • Build and run the group editorial calendar, planned per market around seasonal hooks such as heatwaves, fireworks, International Puppy Day and so on, so we are ready before the news cycle asks.

  • Own our trust and safety transparency reporting: listings blocked, scams intercepted, buyer money protected, illegal import patterns by origin, for distribution to journalists and animal welfare stakeholders alike.

  • Mine breeder reviews, Trustpilot and support conversations for the human stories regional press actually run.

  • Become PMG's press desk, so the journalist relationship belongs to PMG rather than to an agency.

  • Brief and equip country leads and founders as spokespeople: talking points, Q&A, data appendices, prep before interviews.

Requirements

Must-have experience

  • 5+ years in PR, communications or journalism, preferably in-house, with coverage in national or major regional media that you personally landed. Data journalism experience is a strong plus.

  • A track record of building stories out of data rather than distributing press releases. You can spot the angle a journalist will want before they ask, and you are comfortable enough with spreadsheets and dashboards to find it yourself and sanity check a number before a reporter does.

  • Daily, active use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT for research, drafting, localisation and workflow automation. You think in terms of how to leverage yourself through AI, not around it, with a clear view of what to automate and what stays human.

  • Native-level English, written to a standard that needs no editing before it reaches a journalist.

  • Able to operate as a team of one: briefing agencies and freelancers and holding them to account, rather than managing staff beneath you.

Preferable experience

  • Experience in a reputation-exposed marketplace, such as pets, dating, gambling, fintech or the gig economy, or in a category under active regulatory or campaigner scrutiny.

  • Experience running consumer surveys with panels or survey tools.

  • Digital PR fundamentals: earned links, newsjacking, syndication.

You will thrive here if you

  • Have the mindset of a hands-on builder rather than a delegator.

  • Believe process serves outcomes, not the other way around.

  • Value clarity, candour and collaboration.

  • Are excited by the challenge of scaling one of Europe's most impactful consumer marketplaces.

What we offer

  • A function that does not exist yet, yours to design, across seven markets, with a proven UK playbook to build from.

  • A proprietary dataset covering millions of pet and horse transactions that no journalist can get anywhere else.

  • Direct access to founders and country leads.

  • A profitable, growing business rather than a slide deck.

  • A diverse team of more than 100 colleagues across the world.

  • Competitive compensation.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Customer Identity and Access Management
jobs.excerpt: About the teamThe Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) team sits within Foundations Engineering and owns the authentication and authorization platform for one of the most-visited websites in the United States, as well as our associated brands.
jobs.description:
About the team

The Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) team sits within Foundations Engineering and owns the authentication and authorization platform for one of the most-visited websites in the United States, as well as our associated brands. Every sign-in, AI chat, session and permission check across Zillow's brands runs through systems this team builds and operates. We ship services, SDKs, and components that let product teams move quickly on web, mobile and AI interfaces without each team reinventing identity and access management.

We operate like a platform product team, not a gatekeeper. Our customers are the engineers and product teams across Zillow Group, and we measure ourselves by how much faster and safer they can ship because our paved paths exist. Our work spans an authentication platform that securely adapts to users needs as they become more serious about their home buying journey, a fine-grained authorization service designed for high-volume policy evaluation, and a growing set of centralized Customer and Identity services in our Consumer Domain that is the canonical source of truth for who our customers are.

This is a team where technical credibility matters. Our leaders write strategy documents, sit in design reviews, and can reason about token lifetimes and authorization models without a translator. If you have spent your career building platforms that other engineers depend on, this is the kind of organization you have been building toward.

About the role

As Sr. Director of Customer Identity and Access Management, you will own the strategy, execution, and maturity of Zillow's customer identity platform. You will lead three engineering teams through frontline Engineering Managers and directly support two Principal Engineers who anchor the technical direction of the platform.

Three programs define the next two years of this org's work:

  • Centralized Authentication Platform. Consolidating authentication across Zillow Group's brands and surfaces onto a single, well-instrumented platform built on a commercial IdP that we extend substantially to meet consumer scale and experience requirements.

  • Fine-Grained Authorization Platform. Building an authorization service that lets product teams express and evaluate permissions at the resource level, replacing the bespoke and duplicative access logic scattered across applications today.

  • Consumer Domain - Centralized Customer and Identity services. Filling out the domain with authoritative customer and identity services so that profile, account, and entitlement data have one owner and one contract rather than a dozen partial copies.

We are looking for a strong, experienced leader. You come from a high-volume software or platform engineering background and you have never fully left it behind. You can earn trust with Principal Engineers, recruit senior talent who could work anywhere, negotiate roadmaps with internal leadership, and then turn around and frame identity investment in business terms for executives to easily understand. You will set multi-year technical roadmaps, own the operational budget and vendor strategy for your organization, and serve as Zillow's senior voice on customer identity, authentication and authorization.

Responsibilities

Leadership and Organizational Strategy

  • Lead and develop a multi-team organization through frontline Engineering Managers, setting clear direction, healthy team culture, and high-performance expectations at every level.

  • Directly support Principal Engineers who help you understand complex systems, anchor architectural decisions, and identify opportunities to innovate and align.

  • Take broad strategy and focus areas from senior leadership and transform them into technical strategies, objectives, and tactical plans your teams can execute against.

  • Work hand-in-hand with internal and external AI teams and financial platforms to simplify authentication and authorization while adapting our technical solutions to rapidly evolving areas of our business.

  • Establish and execute a 2–3 year roadmap for customer identity that is tightly coupled to product and platform engineering priorities across Zillow Group.

  • Own workforce planning, org design, hiring, and the development of a bench of future engineering leaders. Maintain premeditated succession plans and growth pathways for managers and ICs alike.

  • Manage budget, tooling portfolio, and vendor relationships across your scope, with a clear view of your org's cost profile and its contribution to overall engineering spend.

  • Represent CIAM at the executive level. Translate identity architecture and risk into business impact for leadership.

Centralized Authentication Platform

  • Own the strategy for consolidating authentication across Zillow Group brands, surfaces, and acquisitions onto a single platform, sequencing migrations so partner teams are never blocked.

  • Drive the extension of our commercial Identity Provider into a platform that meets Zillow-specific requirements for consumer experience, scale, and latency, deciding deliberately where to configure the vendor, where to build around it, and where to build our own solutions.

  • Ensure authentication is delivered as a first-class platform capability, with SDKs, reference implementations, and documentation that make correct integration the easy path for product engineers.

  • Set direction on account security capabilities including MFA, step-up and conditional access, session management, and account recovery, balancing security posture against consumer conversion and friction.

  • Partner with Information Security, Privacy, Legal, and Compliance on identity controls, fraud and abuse patterns, and regulatory obligations.

Fine-Grained Authorization Platform

  • Lead the design and delivery of a fine-grained authorization platform capable of high-volume, low-latency policy evaluation across Zillow's product surfaces.

  • Establish the authorization model, policy authoring experience, and migration path that lets product teams move off bespoke, application-embedded access logic.

  • Ensure the platform is instrumented for auditability, so that "who could access what, and when" is an answerable question.

  • Drive adoption across partner orgs. Treat integration count and retired bespoke logic as first-class measures of success, not the shipped service alone.

Consumer Domain: Customer and Identity Services

  • Grow our nascent Consumer Domain with centralized Customer and Identity services, establishing clear ownership, contracts, and canonical sources of truth for customer and identity data.

  • Drive alignment across the domain to eliminate duplicative and partial implementations, reaching across org boundaries where necessary to get the right outcome for Zillow Group.

  • Partner with Product, Data, and downstream consuming teams to define service boundaries that hold up as the business evolves.

  • Design for correctness in identity resolution, data lifecycle, and privacy obligations from the start rather than as a retrofit.

Quality, Reliability, and Operations

  • Remain accountable for execution and quality across your teams through mechanisms — rituals, processes, inspection, reports, metrics, feedback loops — rather than direct involvement in week-to-week delivery.

  • Set the quality bar for systems that are in the critical path of nearly every customer interaction. Authentication outages are company outages.

  • Own availability, latency, and cost targets for your platform. Ensure adequate investment in technical quality is prioritized alongside feature delivery.

  • Ensure sustainable, low-toil on-call practices and a culture of blameless post-incident review with systemic remediation.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $292,200.00 - $466,800.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $277,600.00 - $443,400.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • 12+ years of high-volume engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading through managers in a technology organization where engineering velocity is a first-class value.

  • Roots in software or platform engineering. You have built platforms that dev teams rely on, and your technical instincts remain sharp enough to engage credibly with Principal Engineers and architects.

  • Deep knowledge and experience of identity and access management concepts and best practices: authentication, authorization, multi-factor authentication, conditional access, session and token management.

  • Strong working understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, and JWT, including the failure modes and tradeoffs, not just the specifications.

  • Hands-on background with commercial IAM platforms such as Auth0, Okta, or Ping Identity, including the realities of extending them well beyond out-of-the-box configuration.

  • Experience delivering platform capabilities consumed by many teams, with a track record of driving adoption and retiring the systems you replace.

  • Deep cloud experience (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, etc.) and experience with large-scale application architectures where performance, reliability, scalability, availability, and security are all binding constraints.

  • Demonstrated ability to drive alignment across multiple VP-level orgs and to identify and redress misalignment proactively, acting firmly even when the decision is unpopular.

  • Exceptional communication. You tailor your message from junior engineer to executive, you plan ahead for change management, and you own the message rather than relaying it.

  • A talent magnet. A reputation for hiring, coaching, and developing engineers and managers, with the credibility to attract senior ICs who have options.

  • BS in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.

Standout Experience:

  • Experience building or operating a fine-grained or relationship-based authorization system (Zanzibar-style or similar) at production scale.

  • Experience leading a migration or consolidation of authentication across multiple brands, acquisitions, or legacy systems.

  • Background in high-volume, consumer-scale B2C identity, where conversion and friction are measured alongside security outcomes.

  • Familiarity with domain-driven design and the practical work of establishing canonical services in a large, previously decentralized estate.

  • Proficiency in at least one backend language (Go, Java, Python, or similar), sufficient to review the designs and code your teams produce.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Nearly 9,000 dental practices utilize our platform to practice smarter, generating an average top-line production increase of 50% in the first 12 months.
