Liderar a implantação e evolução da operação de CRM via WhatsApp, integrando Dito + Omnichat + operação das lojas, garantindo implementação tecnológica, desenho dos processos, adoção pelas equipes e geração de resultado comercial.

O PO será o dono do projeto de ponta a ponta, do piloto à escala.

  1. Gestão do projeto e cronograma
    • Construir e acompanhar cronograma, marcos, responsáveis e dependências.
    • Gerenciar backlog, riscos, prioridades e critérios de go/no go.
    • Coordenar CRM, TI, BI, Varejo, Dito e Omnichat.
  2. Implantação e integrações
    • Acompanhar integrações sistêmicas e requisitos funcionais.
    • Preparar ambiente de testes, homologação e produção.
    • Coordenar testes de fluxos, filas, disparos, dados e mensuração.
    • Garantir preparação tecnológica das lojas piloto.
  3. Desenho da operação
    • Construir os fluxos de atendimento, encarteiramento, campanhas, distribuição e transferência de clientes.
    • Definir políticas de gestão de filas, capacidade e SLAs de atendimento.
    • Desenhar jornada de chatbot e regras de transbordo para atendimento humano.
    • Estruturar regras de utilização: o que pode, o que não pode e quais são as exceções.
  4. Papéis e governança
    • Construir matriz clara de responsabilidades entre PO, CRM, TI, gerentes e vendedores.
    • Definir rituais de gestão e acompanhamento da operação.
    • Realizar pautas semanais com lojas e áreas envolvidas para identificar problemas e oportunidades.
  5. Treinamento e adoção
    • Construir materiais, processos e treinamento para gerentes e vendedores.
    • Acompanhar utilização da ferramenta e aderência aos processos.
    • Atuar sobre dificuldades de adoção e necessidades de evolução.
  6. Performance e mensuração
    • Criar relatório diário de acompanhamento da operação.
    • Estruturar comparação entre lojas piloto x lojas controle.
    • Acompanhar volumetria de contatos, clientes ativos, produtividade, conversão e receita.
    • Construir matriz de resultado financeiro e mensurar receita incremental do projeto.
  7. Gestão financeira e escala
    • Gerenciar orçamento do piloto.
    • Projetar custos de plataforma, mensageria, usuários e infraestrutura para expansão.
    • Construir business case e ROI para decisão de escala.
  8. Evolução do produto
    • Identificar oportunidades a partir dos aprendizados do piloto.
    • Priorizar novas jornadas, automações, regras e integrações.
    • Manter roadmap evolutivo da solução.
    • Recomendar escalar, ajustar ou interromper cada iniciativa com base nos resultados.

Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiência em Product Ownership e/ou Gestão de Projetos, com atuação em projetos de implantação de tecnologia e criação de processos e fluxos de trabalho.
  • Domínio de gestão de projetos, incluindo cronogramas, backlog, matriz RACI, riscos, dependências, prioridades e acompanhamento de entregas.
  • Experiência em discovery, levantamento de requisitos e desenho de processos/jornadas, conectando necessidades do negócio às soluções técnicas.
  • Capacidade de orquestrar projetos multidisciplinares, envolvendo áreas de negócio, Tecnologia,CRM, Dados, Varejo e fornecedores externos.
  • Experiência com implantação, treinamento e gestão da mudança, garantindo adoção de novos processos e ferramentas pelos usuários.
  • Domínio de Excel/Google Sheets e PowerPoint, com capacidade para construção de controles, análises, reports e apresentações executivas.
  • Conhecimento em indicadores, orçamento e business cases, incluindo acompanhamento de custos, performance e análise de ROI.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis e ferramentas de gestão de projetos.
Diferenciais
Experiência com operações de varejo físico, CRM, WhatsApp Business/API, atendimento omnichannel ou projetos envolvendo equipes de lojas será considerada um diferencial.

Informações adicionais

Principais entregáveis:

Cronograma e roadmap | Fluxos operacionais | Matriz de responsabilidades | Políticas de atendimento e filas | Jornada do chatbot | Plano de treinamento | Dashboard diário | Piloto x controle | Matriz financeira/ROI | Business case de expansão | Backlog de evoluções.

jobs.excerpt: Facet was founded in 2016 on the belief that objective, personalized financial advice is essential to living well.
jobs.description:
Facet was founded in 2016 on the belief that objective, personalized financial advice is essential to living well. Our mission is to empower people to live more enriched lives by delivering a new standard of advice. By removing asset minimums, we provide holistic planning that goes far beyond investments to address every way money impacts life. Our team of CFP® professionals are at the core of our service and are empowered by our best-in-class support teams and proprietary technology platform. This model allows Facet to integrate advice into our members’ entire financial picture—all for an affordable, flat membership fee.

Our commitment to innovation and member success has earned national recognition, including being ranked the #1 Best Financial Advisory Firm 2025 by USA TODAY and named to Newsweek’s list of America’s Top Financial Advisory Firms 2025. With an A+ BBB Rating and a Trustpilot “Excellent” score (as of Sept. 16, 2025)*, we are proud to be redefining the industry for our members and our team alike.

About The Role

Facet is seeking an experienced Certified Public Accountant (CPA) to step into a high-touch, member-facing role as a Senior Tax Associate. If you love the strategic advisory side of public accounting or private wealth management—but dread tax season, compliance filings, and timesheets—this is the ideal next step in your career.

In this consultative position, you will be on the frontline, leading weekly virtual tax strategy sessions directly with Facet members. You will translate complex tax laws into actionable, high-impact strategies without ever filing a tax return. Partnering closely with our CFP® Lead Planners, you will apply Facet’s modern tax planning framework to empower members to make confident, tax-optimized life decisions.

Key Highlights:

  • No Tax Return Preparation or Compliance: 100% focused on forward-looking planning, education, and member advisory.
  • Direct Member Impact: High-cadence consultation environment leading 10–15 video strategy sessions per week.
  • Modern Wealth Management: Operate as the subject matter expert within a modern, tech-enabled RIA structure.
  • Balanced Work Load: NO BUSY SEASON!

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

  • Direct Member Consultations: Lead 10–15 virtual strategy sessions per week, delivering tailored tax advice, answering complex real-time questions, and guiding members through high-stakes financial decisions.
  • Continuous Member Engagement: Serve as the primary tax sounding board for members by delivering clear, plain-English answers to day-to-day inbound questions via our secure messaging platform (covering withholdings, life events, IRS notices, and tax projections).
  • Proactive Tax Plan Diagnostic: Review member tax returns (Form 1040s and schedules) to diagnose multi-year optimization opportunities, including Roth conversions, equity vesting events, real estate transactions, and executive compensation.
  • Custom Modeling & Scenario Analysis: Build, model, and present customized tax strategies using modern planning tools—focusing on bracket management, withholding adjustments, and estimated tax schedules.
  • Technical Research & Analysis: Perform deep-dive research into complex federal and multi-state tax scenarios to architect compliant, creative strategies across diverse household profiles.
  • Planner Collaboration: Work hand-in-hand with our Lead Planners and Director of Specialized Advice to integrate tax optimization seamlessly into overall holistic financial plans.

Commonly Advised Strategies & Domains

  • Roth Conversion & Income Optimization: Evaluating income streams for multi-year Roth conversion strategies while managing downstream impacts on IRMAA brackets, ACA subsidies, and Social Security taxation.
  • Real Estate & Rental Assets: Advising on cost recovery, depreciation, Passive Activity Loss (PAL) rules, short-term rental strategies, and Section 1031 exchanges.
  • Charitable Giving Strategies: Structuring high-impact options, including Donor-Advised Funds (DAFs), Qualified Charitable Distributions (QCDs), and appreciated stock gifting.
  • Small Business & Entity Structuring: Advising business owners on entity selection (Sole Prop, S-Corp, LLC), Section 199A QBI optimization, pass-through taxation, and exit planning.
  • Equity Compensation: Navigating tax impacts of ISOs, NSOs, RSUs, and ESPPs, including Alternative Minimum Tax (AMT) strategies and liquidity event planning.

Requirements

  • Active Credential:Active Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license required.
  • Relevant Experience: 5–7+ years of professional experience specializing in personal tax planning, private client tax advisory, high-net-worth tax consulting, or wealth management.
  • Member-Facing Excellence: Demonstrated history of managing a regular client meeting cadence (e.g., 10–15 client consultations weekly) with exceptional empathy, active listening, and strong presentation skills over video.
  • Diagnostic Expertise: Expert ability to analyze Form 1040s and supporting schedules rapidly to spot tax inefficiencies, missed opportunities, and exposure risks.
  • Deep Technical Knowledge: Strong expertise in individual federal and state tax codes, pass-through entities, retirement distribution strategies, and executive compensation planning.
  • Fiduciary Ethos: Uncompromising integrity and a dedication to delivering objective, member-first advice.

Preferred Qualifications:

    • Certified Financial Planner (CFP®) designation or active pursuit of the credential.
    • Prior experience delivering advisory services within a fee-only RIA, multi-family office, or wealth management firm alongside CFP® professionals.
    • High proficiency with modern tax modeling tools (Holistiplan, BNA, Corvee) and CRM/digital workflow tools.

Benefits

  • $110,000 – $150,000 base salary: Determined by experience, knowledge, and skills.
  • Equity (ISO): It is important to us that all employees are shareholders in our mission.
  • Flexible PTO
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with employer match, short/long-term disability (paid by Facet), life insurance, and paid parental leave.
  • Certification and wellness reimbursement programs
  • Work from anywhere in the US

*Facet was ranked #1 Best Financial Advisory Firm 2025 by USA TODAY in April 2025 who partnered with Statista to rank the top 500 RIAs. Recommendations were collected via an independent survey among over 30,000 individuals. Self-recommendations were prohibited, and no compensation was provided for the ranking. Facet has been Accredited with the Better Business Bureau® since June 2025, and as of February 2026 holds an A+ BBB Rating. This Accreditation does not imply BBB approval or endorsement. Plant-A Insights Group and Newsweek partnered to identify America's Top Financial Advisory Firms 2025. This analysis was performed with data as of September 2024 and reviewed over 15,000 financial advisories registered with the SEC. These rankings prepared by Plant-A reflect editorial content and no compensation was provided by Facet in connection with America's Top Financial Advisory Firms 2025. As of February 25, 2026; Facet has a 4.8 star rating with TrustPilot.com. TrustPilot uses a formula for calculation that considers three factors: time span, frequency, and Bayesian average. After the calculation, a TrustScore is then visualized into a star rating from 1 to 5 stars, including half stars. Facet’s star rating is calculated from reviews from January of 2022 to present day. Daily star rating may fluctuate. Companies on Trustpilot aren't allowed to offer incentives or pay to hide reviews and Facet has not made any payments in offer or receipt of any reviews.

jobs.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Vous rejoignez une équipe en charge de l’analyse, de la préparation et de l’exécution de projets digitaux. Dans le cadre de la refonte complète d’une application mobile, vous jouez un rôle clé dans la traduction des besoins métier en éléments fonctionnels clairs, cohérents et exploitables par les équipes UX/UI et de développement.

Vous intervenez sur l’ensemble du cycle de définition fonctionnelle jusqu’à la préparation du développement, avec une attention particulière portée à la cohérence entre parcours utilisateurs, écrans, backlog et critères d’acceptation.

Description de mission

Le rôle consiste à faire le lien entre :

  • les besoins métier,
  • l’expérience utilisateur (UX),
  • les équipes design,
  • les équipes de développement,
  • l’architecture,
  • la QA et la gestion de projet.

Vous êtes garant de la structuration des parcours utilisateurs, de la transformation des besoins en spécifications fonctionnelles et de la traçabilité entre les différentes étapes de conception et de delivery.

Responsabilités principales

1. Analyse métier et cadrage fonctionnel

  • Recueillir les besoins métier et utilisateurs.
  • Challenge les demandes afin d’en clarifier les objectifs réels.
  • Structurer les User Journeys et formaliser les parcours détaillés.
  • Identifier les pain points, les cas complexes et les dépendances.
  • Prioriser les besoins avec les parties prenantes du projet.

2. Structuration des parcours utilisateurs

  • Définir les parcours de bout en bout.
  • Décomposer chaque parcours en étapes détaillées.
  • Prendre en compte les variantes, exceptions, cas d’erreur, scénarios offline, dépendances temps réel et besoins d’accessibilité (PMR).
  • Garantir une couverture complète des scénarios critiques et des edge cases.

3. Transformation des besoins en éléments exploitables

Vous structurez et maintenez la traçabilité complète entre :

User Journey → Features → Screens → User Stories → Acceptance Criteria

  • Transformer les besoins métier en fonctionnalités détaillées.
  • Réaliser le screen mapping et contribuer au screen inventory.
  • Formaliser des wireflows fonctionnels clairs.
  • Veiller à l’exhaustivité des écrans et à la cohérence des comportements attendus.

4. Préparation du travail UX/UI

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: About AppFollowAppFollow is an AI-powered app reputation and ASO platform for mobile and Steam publishers.
jobs.description:
About AppFollow

    AppFollow is an AI-powered app reputation and ASO platform for mobile and Steam publishers. Support teams use it to handle reviews at scale, product teams turn user feedback into insights, and marketing and ASO teams grow app store visibility. We're a B2B SaaS company serving SMB, mid-market and enterprise clients, with a remote team based mostly in Europe.

Role overview

    We're hiring our first dedicated Product Marketing Manager. You'll own how AppFollow's products are positioned, launched and explained, both to the market and inside the company.

    You report to the CEO and work with Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success teams, each needing something different from you. Product needs you to understand new features early, turn them into a clear market story and bring back what customers say about them. Marketing needs one person who knows the product inside out and produces the source of truth for campaigns, webinars and landing pages. Sales and Customer Success need positioning against competitors, a current deck and proof they can use in a demo.

    This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role. There's nobody to delegate to, and most of the workflows described below don't exist yet. You'll build them.

Key responsibilities

    Positioning and messaging. Own who we're for, what we do better than competitors, and how that shows up in our messaging. You run this work with the leadership team and carry the result onto the website's product pages and everywhere else the product is described.

    Product launches. Lead every feature launch from the marketing side, from the start of development rather than the week before release. Understand the use cases with the product manager, define the message, build the launch plan and run the campaign to prospects and existing accounts together with Sales. Then measure it: opportunities created, accounts activated.

    Product feedback loop. Join sales and CS calls during betas and launches. Aggregate what prospects and customers say about a new feature (Fathom, AI tooling, your own system), define the questions the sales team should be asking, and feed the findings back to Product and Marketing: what's not landing, what needs to change in messaging or on landing pages, which use cases we're missing.

    Case studies and proof. Own the customer story pipeline: first use cases after each launch, case studies, testimonials. If a key use case has no proof yet, go get it.

    Internal source of truth. For every product and feature, keep a current, plain-language description of what it does, who it's for, why it beats the alternatives, proof points and customer quotes (we use Guru). Marketing, Sales, CS and Growth all work from it. This is not technical documentation.

    Sales and CS materials. Own the master sales deck as a modular set of approved slides and review it with the Head of Sales roughly every quarter. Help Sales find the "wow moment" for demos of new features. Translate features into business outcomes. Sales training and one-off pitch preparation stay with the Head of Sales.

    Cross-sell and upsell. Run announcement campaigns to existing and free accounts around new features and products, and coordinate with Growth on in-product channels.

How we measure success

  • Feature adoption after launch (accounts using a new feature or add-on)

  • Case studies published and launch materials ready on launch day (source of truth, deck, landing page copy)

  • Qualified pipeline (MQLs/SQLs) from product launches and launch campaigns

  • Cross-sell and upsell opportunities from campaigns to the existing base

Who we're looking for

    Experience. 5+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing, most of it in startups where you did the work yourself. You've launched products, owned positioning and worked side by side with sales. Experience in mobile apps, ASO or gaming is a strong plus, as is knowing how both product-led and sales-led motions work.

    Way of working. Proactive. You pick up what's broken without waiting for a launch date or a request from Sales, and you're comfortable saying "this is what we're not doing."

    AI-native. You use Claude, ChatGPT and similar tools daily and build your own workflows on top of them: aggregating call feedback, maintaining product knowledge, drafting content. We expect you to plug into our internal integrations (Fathom, HubSpot, Guru, Salesforce, Amplitude, Canny) and keep the product knowledge base the most current thing in the company.

    Data. Comfortable reading funnel and campaign data, building a spreadsheet and defending a conclusion.

    Communication. Fluent English, strong writing. Another language (Spanish, Portuguese, Russian) is a plus. Comfortable presenting at webinars and events as a public face for the product.

    Video production skills (Screen Studio, CapCut) are a plus, not a requirement.

What we offer

  • Remote role anywhere in Europe; hubs in Spain, Portugal, Serbia and Finland

  • Colleagues across Europe, the UK, the US and Brazil

  • Conference participation in app, gaming and product marketing events

  • Equity options after probation, quarterly performance bonuses

  • Annual offline team meetup and company all-hands

  • Monthly coworking budget, laptop and home office equipment

  • Internal hackathons 2–3 times a year

  • Direct work with the CEO and leadership team; you build a function from zero

Hiring process

  • Applications open: mid-Sept

  • Screening call (30 min): second half of Sept

  • Take-home assignment and panel interview with Sales, Marketing and Product (60 min): early Oct

  • Offer: by 15 Oct

    • Dates are our target and may shift. We move fast and interview as applications come in, so early applicants hear back sooner.

The Area Accountant may act as a resource for accounting and general administrative staff and is responsible for a broad array of accounting duties.

  • Assists the Area Controller in ensuring there are proper internal controls in place including compliance with company policies and procedures, Sarbanes Oxley and all other statutory requirements. In doing so, utilizes discretion and judgment as to matters of significance.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. jobs.description:
Job Family:

The Technical Project Manager will lead the end-to-end planning, execution, governance, and delivery of complex technical initiatives supporting the GrantSolutions contract. Efforts may include application and platform modernization, system enhancements, new capabilities, integrations, cloud adoption, cybersecurity initiatives, and operational improvements. The role requires strong project leadership and sufficient familiarity with AWS cloud environments and Java-based applications to engage technical teams, understand delivery dependencies and risks, and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. The Technical Project Manager will coordinate cross-functional and multi-vendor teams; manage scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality, risks, dependencies, and change; and partner with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, architects, engineering and operations leads, executive leadership, and Federal stakeholders to achieve measurable outcomes.

What You Will Do:

We are seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager to lead a diverse portfolio of technical efforts, including modernization initiatives, system and application enhancements, new capability delivery, platform improvements, integrations, and technology upgrades. This role will manage delivery from initiation through deployment and transition to operations, coordinating work across multiple workstreams, vendors, and agile teams while maintaining service continuity and alignment with business priorities.

The Technical Project Manager will establish delivery baselines and governance, manage requirements and change, track performance and financials, facilitate technical and business decisions, and coordinate quality, security, release, operational readiness, and stakeholder adoption. This individual will support initiatives involving cloud-hosted applications, integrations, shared services, data exchanges, infrastructure, and emerging capabilities. Success requires sound judgment, technical curiosity, concise executive communication, and the ability to create accountability without displacing the responsibilities of Product Owners, Scrum Masters, architects, or Technical Leads.

  • Lead projects through initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and control, deployment, transition to operations, and closeout, with clear acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes.

  • Define and maintain project charters, scope, objectives, work breakdown structures, integrated schedules, resource plans, budgets, delivery roadmaps, and governance cadence.

  • Manage day-to-day execution across multiple agile teams, technical workstreams, vendors, and shared services; clarify roles, commitments, interfaces, and decision rights.

  • Partner with Product Owners and technical leads to translate business and technical requirements into prioritized, achievable release plans while maintaining traceability from objectives through delivered capabilities.

  • Manage scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, procurement and vendor commitments, risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, decisions, and corrective actions using appropriate controls.

  • Own project financial management, including budgets, forecasts, burn rates, variance analysis, Estimate at Completion, Estimate to Complete, and timely escalation of financial risks.

  • Establish and administer integrated change control, assessing proposed changes for business value and impacts to architecture, scope, cost, schedule, security, operations, and contractual commitments.

  • Coordinate architecture, application development, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, privacy, data, testing, configuration management, and operations stakeholders to meet delivery and governance requirements.

  • Drive release and operational readiness, including environment and integration dependencies, test completion, defect disposition, data migration, deployment planning, rollback and contingency planning, training, communications, support readiness, and production handoff.

  • Track technical dependencies across applications, cloud services, APIs, data exchanges, security components, environments, and shared platform capabilities.

  • Coordinate delivery planning for AWS-hosted environments and Java-based applications, working with technical leads to understand architecture, security, integration, deployment, and operational considerations.

  • Proactively manage implementation and transition risks, including workflow continuity, system-of-record decisions, overlapping capabilities, data synchronization, technical debt, testing scope, deployment sequencing, and operational impacts.

  • Define and monitor delivery metrics and key performance indicators, such as milestone performance, forecast accuracy, throughput, cycle time, quality trends, defect leakage, dependency aging, and risk exposure; use data to drive recovery plans and continuous improvement.

  • Prepare concise executive dashboards, weekly and monthly status reports, decision briefs, and forecasts that clearly communicate progress, financial status, risks, dependencies, tradeoffs, and decisions required.

  • Facilitate planning sessions, technical reviews, risk reviews, stakeholder forums, retrospectives, and decision meetings; document actions, owners, due dates, and outcomes.

  • Manage vendor performance against plans, deliverables, service expectations, quality criteria, and contractual obligations, escalating gaps and coordinating remediation.

  • Maintain complete, audit-ready project records, including baselines, plans, RAID logs, decisions, approvals, change records, status reports, meeting outcomes, and lessons learned.

  • Build trusted relationships across Federal stakeholders, vendors, architects, delivery teams, and operations partners while promoting accountability, constructive conflict resolution, team empowerment, and a culture of continuous improvement.

What You Will Need:

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Federal or DoD Public Trust; approved adjudication is required before onboarding. An active Public Trust or suitability determination is preferred.

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, business, project management, or a related field.

  • Minimum of Twelve (12) years of prior relevant experience

  • Minimum of ten (10) years of experience managing complex software development, cloud, systems integration, infrastructure, data, cybersecurity, or enterprise technology initiatives.

  • Demonstrated success managing end-to-end delivery across multiple teams, vendors, and stakeholder groups, including projects in which legacy and modern platforms operate concurrently.

  • Strong command of project management disciplines, including scope, schedule, cost, resource, quality, procurement, risk, communications, stakeholder, and change management.

  • Experience using Agile, Scrum, Kanban, hybrid, and predictive delivery approaches, with the judgment to tailor practices to project risk, complexity, governance, and contractual needs.

  • Working knowledge of the software development lifecycle and modern delivery practices, including cloud environments, application development, integrations, testing, release management, cybersecurity, DevSecOps, and operational readiness.

  • Experience managing technical initiatives involving AWS cloud environments and Java-based applications, with the ability to understand dependencies, risks, tradeoffs, and operational impacts at a project-management level.

  • Ability to understand architecture diagrams, interface dependencies, technical tradeoffs, nonfunctional requirements, and security or compliance constraints, and translate them into actionable plans without serving as the solution architect.

  • Experience establishing governance, baselines, stage gates, acceptance criteria, metrics, dashboards, and audit-ready project documentation.

  • Strong financial management skills, including budgeting, estimating, forecasting, variance analysis, EAC, ETC, and resource capacity planning.

What Would Be Nice To Have:

  • PMP certification; PMI-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster, SAFe, ITIL, or comparable agile, service management, or scaled delivery certification.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify root causes, evaluate options, manage ambiguity, resolve conflict, negotiate commitments, and drive timely risk-based decisions.

  • Exceptional written, verbal, facilitation, and executive presentation skills, with the ability to communicate technical information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strong stakeholder and vendor management skills, with a collaborative, accountable, customer-focused, and solution-oriented leadership style.

  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Project or an equivalent scheduling tool and working proficiency with Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, and dashboard or reporting tools.

  • Self-motivated and adaptable, with strong organizational skills, attention to detail, sound professional judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.

  • Experience delivering federal or regulated technology programs aligned with government lifecycle, cybersecurity, accessibility, privacy, records management, and audit requirements.

  • Experience supporting delivery of AWS-hosted applications, Java-based systems, APIs, integrations, or DevSecOps-enabled initiatives.

  • AWS or related cloud certification and familiarity with enterprise Java application environments.

  • Experience managing API-enabled integration layers, data exchange patterns, canonical data models, identity and access integration, or interface-control processes.

  • Experience leading multi-vendor delivery within a shared enterprise architecture and managing contractual deliverables, service levels, subcontractor dependencies, and vendor remediation plans.

  • Experience with organizational change management, user-centered design, training, communications, adoption, and transition-to-operations activities.

  • Experience applying quantitative delivery metrics, earned value or comparable performance-management techniques, root-cause analysis, and lessons learned to improve predictability and outcomes.

  • Self-motivated and adaptable, with strong organizational skills, attention to detail, sound professional judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.

  • Collaborative leadership: Builds alignment around a shared vision, sets clear expectations, delegates effectively, and empowers teams to take ownership of outcomes.

  • Emotional intelligence: Demonstrates self-awareness, empathy, composure, and situational awareness when navigating high-pressure environments and diverse perspectives.

  • Communication and active listening: Communicates with clarity and transparency, tailors messages to the audience, asks thoughtful questions, and confirms shared understanding.

  • Influence and negotiation: Builds consensus and secures commitments across teams and stakeholders, including situations where direct authority is limited.

  • Conflict resolution: Addresses disagreement early, facilitates constructive dialogue, separates issues from individuals, and drives practical, equitable resolutions.

  • Adaptability and resilience: Remains calm and effective amid shifting priorities, incomplete information, technical complexity, and delivery pressure.

  • Decisiveness and accountability: Makes timely, evidence-based decisions, communicates tradeoffs, follows through on commitments, and holds self and others constructively accountable.

  • Integrity and trust: Models ethical behavior, discretion, reliability, transparency, and respect in interactions with clients, partners, and team members.

  • Coaching and team development: Provides actionable feedback, recognizes contributions, supports professional growth, and creates psychological safety for questions, learning, and responsible escalation.

  • Inclusive collaboration: Values varied expertise and perspectives, promotes respectful participation, and fosters productive partnerships across technical, business, vendor, and Federal teams.

  • Soft Skills and Leadership Qualities:

jobs.excerpt: About Scaling. comScaling. com helps established business owners 10x their companies in three years or less.
jobs.description:
About Scaling.com

Scaling.com helps established business owners 10x their companies in three years or less. As far as we know, we are the only true scaling research advisory firm in the world. Not “growth,” but scale.

We work with entrepreneurs doing $1 million or more in revenue (With many of our clients between $100M and $1B+) who are ready to stop being the bottleneck and build a company that scales.

Our creative library includes multiple NYT best-selling books, large podcast appearances, keynotes, live events, client/member interviews, case studies, client/member training material, webinars, founder content, and hundreds of verified customer stories.

Why This Role Exists

Scaling.com tests hundreds of hooks each week. When the market tells us a hook is working, this role turns that signal into a larger family of direct-response video ads. We are looking for someone who has already written high-performing video creative and scripts at the volume and quality required to support multiple millions of dollars in monthly ad spend.

You will not begin with a blank page. You will receive a winning hook, a proven video ad, or a clear performance signal. Your job is to understand why it worked, find the strongest evidence and source material connected to it in our media library, develop the angle, write new versions, and hand the production team a clear creative direction that can become a finished ad.

This is primarily a video-ad strategy and scriptwriting role. It combines direct-response strategy, AI-assisted research, source mining, writing, creative iteration, and performance learning. You should also be capable of handling other direct-response copywriting needs when required, but video scripts are the center of the job.

Requirements

Your Core Workflow

  • Receive winning hooks, proven video ads, winners and losers, hook data, creative references, and testing requests from our Head of Content and paid-media team.
  • Diagnose why it worked: the audience, pain, belief, promise, proof, curiosity, identity, or objection it activated. Continually contribute original concepts, competitor references, and new test ideas to the team's shared concept pool.
  • Use AI to search our content database for supporting material across testimonials, founder podcasts, books, posts, keynotes, trainings, member stories, and excerpts from our twice-yearly live events. Stay deeply current by regularly consuming our books, every founder podcast appearance and keynote, live-event content, trainings, and the weekly case-study podcast produced for our members.
  • Build an evidence bank around the angle. This may include dozens of testimonials, short proof points, founder clips, book lines, customer language, objections, and supporting stories.
  • Write three or four new hook options, develop the body, choose the proof sequence, and create a clear flow for the video ad.
  • Package the developed angle for a Creative Producer and Editor. Give them the message, key lines, source material, intended flow, and what the ad must accomplish without prescribing every visual decision.
  • Review the finished ad to protect the strategy and clarify anything that was lost in execution.
  • When an ad wins, create new variations by changing the hook, body, proof, order, framing, or CTA, and by recombining elements from multiple winners.
  • When the paid-media team flags a winning ad for refresh, identify what should be preserved and what should change so the next version can beat it.
  • Repeat the cycle quickly. Some ads may only perform for a few weeks because we intend to scale spend aggressively.

What You Own

  • Winning-hook expansion
  • Angle development
  • AI-assisted source research
  • Testimonial and proof mining
  • Video ad scripts and copy
  • Hook and body variations
  • Creative briefs and source packages
  • Winner iteration
  • Winner refreshes
  • Performance learning
  • Claim and source accuracy

What Success Looks Like

  • A dependable flow of strong, evidence-backed angles keeps the production team moving.
  • New video ads come from proven market signals without becoming minor copies of the original.
  • Winning video ads produce useful creative families as the paid-media team scales them.
  • Research is fast, deep, traceable, and materially improves the writing.
  • Editors and designers receive enough direction to protect the message while still owning the execution.
  • The work produces qualified demand, not merely clicks or internal enthusiasm.

What We Need to See

  • Direct-response video-ad work with clear personal ownership and measurable outcomes such as spend, qualified leads, booked calls, conversion, revenue, or lift against a control. Your past work should demonstrate the volume, quality, and judgment required to sustain multiple millions of dollars in monthly ad spend.
  • The ability to explain why a hook or ad worked and how you turned that learning into the next test.
  • Experience selling a complex, intangible, high-consideration offer. Expert-led, education, or information businesses are strongly preferred.
  • Strong research judgment across transcripts, testimonials, long-form content, books, customer language, and performance data.
  • A real AI-enabled research and writing workflow that increased speed or creative range without producing generic work.
  • Fast, decisive collaboration with producers, editors, and designers.
  • Excellent judgment around claims, testimonials, attribution, and source accuracy.

This Role Is Not

  • Brand copy without a measurable action
  • Generic content strategy
  • Starting every assignment from a blank page
  • Prompt output passed off as thinking
  • A writer who disappears after handoff
  • A project-management layer between strategy and production

How to Apply

Send one direct-response video ad or campaign you personally shaped. Explain the original signal or insight, the audience, the hook, the angle, the proof, the measurable result, and what you created next. Include the numbers and your exact ownership.

Then show us how you use AI to search, organize, and turn a large body of source material into a stronger ad. We want to see the workflow and the finished result, not a list of tools.

Benefits

  • PTO
  • US Holidays

Market Intelligence & VOC

  • Conduct systematic competitive intelligence: tracking competitor product launches, pricing, application claims, and go-to-market moves — translating intelligence into actionable competitive response recommendations

Market Requirements Documents (MRDs)

  • Own the segment's Market Requirements Document — the structured, evidence-based articulation of customer needs, competitive gaps, and product investment priorities for the assigned segment across all relevant PerkinElmer product lines

Thought Leadership & External Presence

  • Develop segment-specific thought leadership content: white papers, application note series themes, scientific conference presentations, and regulatory commentary that establishes PerkinElmer as a knowledgeable, credible voice in the segment

  • Segment growth contribution — revenue growth in the assigned segment vs. prior year and vs. market growth rate

  • Competitive win rate in the segment — tracked through win/loss analysis

Preferred

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer Performance & Scalability
jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer, Performance & Scalability who doesn't wait to be told what to test.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer, Performance & Scalability who doesn't wait to be told what to test. You'll own performance and scalability across our platform, 30+ microservices, event-driven flows, and the legacy dependencies that come with a real production system at scale. This isn't a "run a load test before release" role. This is a role where you make performance a first-class concern from day one, where you define the thresholds that decide pass or fail, and where you hold the bar when something is degrading and nobody yet knows why.

You'll be the performance voice in every room you walk into, design discussions, architecture reviews, incident retrospectives. When latency spikes, you're already halfway through the trace. When a new service is being scoped, performance is already in the delivery plan because you put it there.

What you can expect to be doing:

  • Own Performance from Day One - You embed performance thinking into the delivery plan before code is written, not as an afterthought before release. You make performance testing a natural part of how teams build and ship — not a gate they hit at the end.

  • Define What Good Looks Like - You own the thresholds, metrics, and SLOs that govern pass or fail. You decide what a breach means, you set the budgets (latency, error rate, throughput), and you make those signals objective enough that a pipeline can act on them without a human reading graphs.

  • Test Services in Isolation, at Production Scale - You design and build performance tests for individual services, stubbing downstream and third-party dependencies so each journey is tested on its own merits. You map load to real production traffic to find where things bend and where they break.

  • Lead Performance in CI - You integrate performance testing into CI/CD so regressions are caught automatically, early, and fast. You own the fail-fast signals and keep them trustworthy.

  • Build Reusable, Scalable Assets - You build performance tests as code, reusable components, templates, and utilities that scale across teams and services. You handle data seeding and test setup so runs are repeatable and realistic.

  • Diagnose, Don't Just Report - You root-cause regressions across the stack, reading logs and tracing requests through distributed systems to find the source yourself rather than waiting for someone to hand it to you.

  • Reach Out and Drive Outcomes - You engage the right stakeholders, engineering, platform, product - to turn findings into fixes. You don't file a report and walk away; you drive the outcome.

  • Influence Decisions - You raise performance and scalability risks early, challenge assumptions constructively, and bring people with you. When a design won't scale, you say so before it ships.

What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years in performance engineering, with a track record of owning performance across complex, modern systems, not just executing someone else's load test.

  • Deep performance testing expertise. Hands-on experience designing realistic load models, running load, stress, soak and spike tests, and interpreting results meaningfully.

  • K6 or similar - You have real, hands-on depth with k6 for building and running performance tests.

  • Monitoring and observability know-how. You're comfortable with tools like Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch or similar, and you use them proactively to correlate test results with what the system is actually doing, not just when something is already on fire.

  • Strong programming ability. You're extremely strong in at least one language. We use TypeScript across our stack; if your fundamentals are solid in another language, we're confident you'll pick it up fast.

  • Microservices and distributed systems. You understand service-oriented architectures, dependencies, and the realities of testing a service in isolation — stubbing, mocking, contract boundaries, as well as end-to-end.

  • CI/CD fluency - You've integrated performance testing into CI/CD pipelines and understand how to keep feedback fast and signals reliable. Experience with AWS infrastructure is strongly preferred.

  • Strong communication and presence. You participate fully in agile ceremonies and cross-team conversations. You don't sit quietly when something needs to be said

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, wealth management, or regulated financial services.

  • Experience using AI-assisted tooling to accelerate performance work.

  • Contributions to internal quality guilds, communities of practice, or engineering culture initiatives.

  • Experience mentoring engineers on performance and testing best practices.

What we’re really looking for: ✍️

Beyond the skills and the experience, we want someone who operates with ownership and independence. You don't wait for permission to improve something. You see a gap in coverage, a flaky test, a missing dashboard — and you fix it. You treat the Wealth Management experience line as yours, and you hold yourself to the same standard you hold the product to.

You're not a gatekeeper. You're a quality enabler. And you make every team you work with better at shipping reliable software.

Interested? We'd love to hear from you. Apply and tell us about a time you changed how quality worked on a team, not just what you tested, but how you made testing better for everyone around you.

In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

jobs.excerpt: The bright side of mortgages nesto is Canada’s leading digital residential mortgage lender, offering Canadians the lowest rates from the get-go — with total transparency and no haggling.
jobs.description:
The bright side of mortgages

nesto is Canada’s leading digital residential mortgage lender, offering Canadians the lowest rates from the get-go — with total transparency and no haggling.

About Us

As Canada's pioneer in online mortgage lending, nesto is transforming the way Canadians finance their homes. Our mission is to offer a positive, empowering, and transparent property financing experience, simplified from start to finish.

Borrowers benefit from rates that are often lower than those offered by the big banks, along with an exceptional end-to-end mortgage experience powered by best-in-class AI technology. Fast, simple, and fully digital, nesto has been recognized as CLA Lender of the Year for three consecutive years. That's the bright side of mortgages.

Nesto Group

Nesto Group is Canada's leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, with more than CAD $80 billion in residential and commercial mortgages under administration. Trusted by many of the country's leading financial institutions, we combine over 50 years of mortgage expertise with proprietary cloud and AI technology to transform the future of lending.

Powered by our proprietary cloud and AI technology, nesto has become one of Canada's fastest-growing mortgage lenders, gaining market share across direct-to-consumer (D2C) residential lending, the broker channel, and multi-family commercial lending. Recognized as one of Deloitte's Fast 50 companies for three consecutive years, we continue to push the industry forward through innovation, technology, and customer-focused solutions.

Operating through our family of brands—CMLS, nesto, and Nesto Cloud—our mission is to build Canada's mortgage ecosystem of the future and create a true Canadian champion in lending technology and financial services. Learn more at:

Life at nesto

At nesto, we're passionate about challenging the status quo and building a better mortgage experience and saving money on their mortgages for Canadians. We foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and creativity where every team member is empowered to take ownership, make an impact, and grow. If you're looking to solve meaningful problems alongside ambitious, supportive teammates, you'll feel right at home here.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Where you sit.

You'll be joining the Origination stream, the product area responsible for the end-to-end mortgage journey, covering self-serve and advisor-supported application flows, underwriting, decisioning, and funding.

This is a Senior PM role where part of your mandate is to help shape and own your specific substream within origination. You'll work closely with the stream lead, and together you'll define the boundaries of your focus area based on your strengths, the team's needs, and where the biggest opportunities are. It's a rare chance to have real influence over your own scope from day one.

Your closest collaborators will be engineering teams building on Nesto Cloud, mortgage operations and underwriting experts who live inside these processes daily, and the brokers and advisors who depend on these tools to serve clients.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Act as one of the primary origination subject-matter experts for your substream, deeply understanding end-to-end origination processes, regulatory requirements, and operational realities.
  • Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and feature prioritization for your area, ensuring it reflects real-world origination requirements, operational efficiencies, and compliance considerations.
  • Identify and assess the impact of new lending features, regulatory changes, and origination workflow evolutions to help shape product direction and support strategic decisions.
  • Work closely with engineering, design, QA, operations, and compliance to validate designs and proposed solutions, ensuring they align with origination best practices and industry standards.
  • Support the backlog refinement process by prioritizing origination-related epics and stories, balancing customer experience, operational needs, and technical feasibility.
  • Participate in release planning, UAT, and pre-launch readiness to ensure origination use cases are fully supported, edge cases are addressed, and downstream impacts are understood.
  • Conduct research on industry trends, evolving regulations, origination technologies, and competitor approaches, bringing insights to guide product evolution.
  • Create and maintain detailed documentation of origination processes, scenarios, requirements, and system behaviours to support product teams and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Act as the go-to expert for your origination workflows, answering questions, supporting issue triage, and ensuring the product supports exceptional origination experiences across all lending products.

AI-Augmented Ways of Working

  • Actively use AI tools (Cursor, Claude, Figma AI, Gemini, and others) to accelerate your PM workflow from discovery through delivery: synthesizing research, prototyping ideas, and measuring results.
  • Don't wait for a perfect process to test a hypothesis. Use the tools available to you to get to answers faster, whether that means building a rough prototype, running a quick experiment, or drafting a solution to pressure-test with users before it becomes a roadmap item.
  • Comfortable going beyond traditional PM boundaries when the situation calls for it, the best people here don't hand off and wait, they stay close to the work and use every tool at their disposal to move it forward.
  • Stay ahead of how AI is reshaping mortgage origination and bring informed recommendations to the roadmap.
  • Share what you discover. How you work should make the people around you better.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The profile.

  • 5-7+ years of hands-on experience in product management, ideally with exposure to mortgage origination, lending, or a closely adjacent regulated financial services environment.
  • Understanding of end-to-end origination functions from application flows, document collection, underwriting, credit decisioning to compliance checkpoints, and funding processes.
  • Knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements related to mortgage and consumer lending, including provincial regulations, OSFI guidelines, insurance requirements, and reporting obligations.
  • Experience working with origination platforms, LOS systems, or lending technology, with the ability to translate operational needs into functional system requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, design, operations, compliance, and QA teams.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills with an ability to anticipate downstream impacts and foresee edge cases in origination workflows.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex origination concepts clearly to non-experts in Product and Engineering.
  • Proven, active fluency with AI tools across your PM workflow : discovery, testing, documentation, analysis, and measurement. We will ask you specifically how you use them.

PREFERRED BUT NOT A MUST

  • Experience with other lending products such as HELOC, personal loans, private lending, reverse mortgages, or construction financing.
  • Familiarity with broker and advisor-facing workflows and the nuances of supported versus self-serve client journeys.
  • Exposure to AI or ML-assisted decisioning, document intelligence, or automation in a financial services context.

YOU SHOULDN'T APPLY IF
Be honest with yourself.

  • You're only comfortable in a well-defined product area. This role requires you to help shape your own scope: ambiguity is the starting condition, not an exception.
  • You treat AI tools as a curiosity rather than a daily accelerant.
  • You hand off a PRD and consider your job done. Ownership here runs from discovery all the way through to measuring results in production.
  • You don't thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, and sometimes ambiguous environment.
  • You are not open to experimentation and continuous improvement.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

How we get to know each other.

  • Recruiter Screen – 30 minutes
  • Discovery Call with Director of Product – 30 minutes
  • Take-home Assignment followed by Presentation and Q&A – 60 minutes
  • Final Stakeholder Interview – 45 minutes
  • Criminal Record and Reference Checks + Offer

Why You'll Love Working Here

We believe great people do their best work when they're supported professionally, personally, and financially. That's why we offer a comprehensive rewards package designed to help you thrive at every stage of your career.

  • Competitive Rewards — Competitive compensation, performance incentives (where applicable), and recognition for your contributions.
  • Health & Wellness — Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, Health & Wellness Spending Accounts (where applicable), telemedicine, Employee Assistance Programs, and mental health support for you and your family.
  • Time to Recharge — Generous vacation (4 weeks), floater days, and statutory holidays to help you recharge.
  • Planning for the Future — RRSP matching to support your long-term financial wellbeing.
  • Family Support — Enhanced maternity and parental leave top-up programs.
  • Learning & Growth — Education assistance, mentorship, training, and opportunities to build your career across Nesto Group.
  • Tools for Success — Modern technology, collaborative teams, and the resources you need to do your best work.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Nesto Group, we believe diverse perspectives make us stronger. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to succeed.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, including Indigenous Peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis), persons with disabilities, members of racialized communities, women, and members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community.

If you require accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, we are committed to working with you to meet your needs.

Reporting directly to the Group Chief People Officer you will be responsible for leading on EMED Group’s strategy for learning and organisational development, internal and external communications, partnership engagement and social values, ensuring these areas are aligned to operational and strategic priorities to support the capability, leadership culture and social impact needed to deliver exceptional patient care, operational excellence and sustainable growth.

  • Cash-plan benefits, providing colleagues the option of protecting themselves in case of illness and recuperation, including dental, optical, chiropody.
  • Access to mental health and physiotherapy consultations.
  • Access to legal advice on domestic issues e.g. motoring offences, wills and probate, and personal injury.
  • Long Service Recognition Scheme – recognising colleagues for their continued service after 5 years and at 5-year intervals with an increase in annual leave.

Role Responsibilities

  • Develop, lead and implement the Group Learning & Development Strategy, aligned to EMED’s People Strategy, organisational objectives and future capability requirements.
  • Partner with the Chief People Officer, Executive Leadership Team, senior leaders and operational leaders to identify capability gaps and design learning solutions that support business priorities.
  • Design and oversee leadership and management development programmes for Managers, including the Manager Acceleration Programme and associated pathways.
  • Lead succession planning and talent development activity in partnership with HR Business Partners and senior leaders, ensuring learning supports future leadership pipelines.
  • Work collaboratively with the Training team, clinical, quality, governance, safeguarding, information governance, health and safety and operational colleagues to ensure learning responsibilities are clearly defined and support safe, compliant and high-quality patient care.
  • Maximise effective use of the Apprenticeship Levy and develop apprenticeship pathways that support frontline colleagues, managers and senior leaders.
  • Promote professional qualifications and structured development routes that enhance capability, retention and career progression.
  • Lead the development and effective delivery of internal communications channels that connect colleagues with corporate news, organisational priorities, celebrations, successes and key messages across EMED Group.
  • Work with senior leaders, operational teams and enabling functions to ensure internal communications support engagement, change, culture, colleague voice and shared organisational identity.
  • Provide leadership for internal social value activity delivered through the EMED Foundation, ensuring activity is aligned to EMED’s organisational values, community impact objectives and wider people strategy.
  • Support the leadership of EMED Foundation activity via the Trustees to deliver campaigns, colleague involvement and associated governance to ensure social value initiatives are visible, meaningful and connected to local and national priorities.
  • Work in conjunction with the Talent Resourcing team to identify and develop social value, employability, outreach and partnership activity that supports attraction, resourcing, community engagement and inclusive workforce development.
  • Build effective internal and external partnerships that support the delivery of social value commitments, including charitable relationships, community stakeholders, education partners and resourcing-related initiatives.
  • Develop opportunities to embed lived experience within colleague learning and induction, including investment in a patient-focused video that helps colleagues understand the experience of being a dialysis patient. This should include scoping an outline budget for partners to work within and ensuring the content supports empathy, awareness and patient-centred practice.
  • Work with charitable and social value partners to strengthen EMED’s external value proposition, including exploring how partner insight and content can support social value development within bids, particularly where increased weighting may be expected in future commissioning and procurement processes.
  • Planning, prioritisation, budget awareness and strategic leadership of the Learning & Development function, with potential future responsibility for team leadership as the function evolves.

Do you have what it takes?

  • Communication with Impact – articulates strategy to influence stakeholders, communicates decisively during uncertainty, inspires confidence and ensures ownership and clarity when delivering messages across teams, stakeholders, external partners and the wider business.
  • Agile Thinking – adjusts long-term plans and organisational strategies in response to changing needs, promotes collaboration across teams and proactively manages risks through experimentation, learning and innovation.
  • Delivering Results – aligns team efforts with organisational objectives, establishes clear metrics, integrates financial understanding into decision making and adapts strategies using insight to deliver commercial and operational impact.
  • Encouraging Ownership and Teamwork – empowers team members by assigning responsibility based on strengths, breaks down silos, promotes shared accountability and actively mentors others to strengthen capability.
  • Customer Focussed – ensures the organisation understands and responds to evolving customer, patient and service user needs, integrating their perspectives into strategic decision making and cross-functional delivery.
  • Delivering Clarity of Vision – develops and communicates a compelling vision for learning and organisational capability, aligning it with EMED’s strategic priorities, future workforce needs and long-term objectives.
  • Investing in Talent – actively leads succession planning, develops talent pipelines, establishes mentoring and sponsorship approaches and invests in leadership development to strengthen organisational capability.
  • Leading with Influence – engages and influences key stakeholders at a strategic level, builds credibility as a thought leader, and leads learning, engagement, social value and change initiatives that secure support for transformation and long-term success.
  • Leading Change – communicates the case for change, builds confidence through uncertainty, addresses resistance constructively and fosters a culture of innovation, continuous improvement and learning.

About Us

EMED Group is an established healthcare logistics provider that enables access to health and social care through our four specialist divisions. We are one of the largest health and care partners to the NHS with 4,000 colleagues across over 60 bases UK-wide.

EMED Group is committed to pro-actively improving the wellbeing of our communities by providing access to vital health and social care services across the UK.

EMED Group are committed to providing services for our patients, service users, clients, and community and is supported by employees with an increasing variety of backgrounds. To do this effectively it is essential that we promote equality and embrace diversity and inclusion and treat all of our employees, patients, service users and clients with dignity and respect.

EMED Group is committed to encouraging equality, diversity and inclusion among our workforce, and eliminating unlawful discrimination, with our aim being to be truly representative of all sections of society and our clients, and for each employee to feel respected, valued and able to give their best.

EMED Group are committed to providing equal opportunities and we endeavour to provide an inclusive and safe working culture for all.
